This differs from the foundry interpreter contract.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D393 Formula evaluation always computes perturbations and has distinct numeric limits.md

findings.title: Formula covariance and equivalence proofs are local and input-scoped
findings.body: Covariance validation checks each pair bound and final propagated variance for the current sensitivity vector, not positive semidefiniteness of the whole covariance matrix. Equivalence compares variable-name sets/output dimension and supplied cases, not every variable dimension/domain or symbolic identity. Empty cases correctly yield false; nonfinite tolerances are not explicitly rejected.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D394 Formula covariance and equivalence proofs are local and input-scoped.md

findings.title: Cognitive facade validity and health have limited denominators
findings.body: Facade defaults outer valid to true when a handler lacks valid, so a well-formed equivalent false result is a successful dispatch. Health executes small logic/probability/constraint fixtures while listing13 operations, leaving formula and other families unprobed there. Common stable_hash uses default=str and permits nonfinite JSON numbers; it is not a strict typed identity schema.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D395 Cognitive facade validity and health have limited denominators.md

findings.title: Logic exceptions are monotonic firing guards rather than truth maintenance
findings.body: Rules execute in descending priority and ID order; once support is added it is not retracted if an exception is derived later. Reordering rules can therefore change retained conclusions. Rule IDs need not be unique and derivation support uses only rule:id. Literals are ground exact tuples, without variable unification or unrestricted theorem proving.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D396 Logic exceptions are monotonic firing guards rather than truth maintenance.md

findings.title: Logic result hash excludes appended queries
findings.body: KnowledgeBase.infer hashes atoms/derivations before reason appends the queries list. The nested result_sha256 therefore does not bind the complete returned result. Facade adds a separate hash of that result. max_rounds bounds rounds only; rule/fact count and retained support remain unbounded.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D397 Logic result hash excludes appended queries.md

findings.title: Abduction output limit does not bound subset enumeration
findings.body: Hypothesis count is capped24, but max_combination_size is only clamped to the count, allowing every nonempty subset; max_candidates slices after all valid candidates are retained and sorted. Default size4 is smaller but caller can raise it. Nonmapping hypotheses are silently dropped, and stripped IDs differ from raw by_id keys, causing whitespace-ID lookup failure.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D398 Abduction output limit does not bound subset enumeration.md

findings.title: Bayesian dependence damping depends on caller order and overrides
findings.body: Within a declared group, default weights are1/sqrt(n) in input order, so exchanging unequal likelihood records changes their influence. Caller dependence_weight may override to1 for each. Zero prior/likelihood remains impossible, and all-live-zero evidence correctly rejects. These are declared-likelihood updates, not learned dependence estimation or evidence authentication.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D399 Bayesian dependence damping depends on caller order and overrides.md

findings.title: Information value uses supplied post-test utilities and calibration coerces outcomes
findings.body: VOI validates probability sums and finite nonnegative costs but receives best_expected_utility per outcome rather than solving posterior decisions or running tests. Calibration converts outcomes with int before binary checking, so fractional values can be truncated into accepted0/1. Collection sizes/bins have no upper bound.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D400 Information value uses supplied post-test utilities and calibration coerces outcomes.md

findings.title: Constraint search distinguishes exhausted budget only in a separate flag
findings.body: No found solution sets satisfiable false even when node_budget_exhausted true, which is not an unsatisfiability proof. The budget check precedes complete-assignment acceptance, so reaching it exactly can omit that leaf. Nonmapping constraints are filtered out; repr-based domain/all_different uniqueness differs from eq value equality. Recursive depth is not bounded by variable count policy.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D401 Constraint search distinguishes exhausted budget only in a separate flag.md

findings.title: Causal path results and operation dispatch omit some completeness signals
findings.body: Effect paths obey caller limit/depth but report no truncation flag. Unknown operation strings fall into graph description rather than rejection. Nodes/edges deduplicate in adjacency while description retains duplicate supplied edge rows; Kahn remainder called cycle nodes can include blocked descendants. Valid backdoor/separation results remain conditional on the supplied DAG.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D402 Causal path results and operation dispatch omit some completeness signals.md

findings.title: Temporal projection advances through invalid and simultaneous transitions
findings.body: Timeline records errors for prohibited transitions but still updates current state to each target. Empty allowed_transitions disables validation; equal timestamps sort by ID and can affect projected final state. Zero-duration intervals are accepted although standard proper-interval relation assumptions differ. All pairwise interval relations are materialized without a count cap.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D403 Temporal projection advances through invalid and simultaneous transitions.md

findings.title: Decision scores depend on supplied feasibility and candidate population
findings.body: Constraints are trusted violation lists, not evaluated predicates. Metrics normalize over all eligible candidates, so adding an alternative changes utility scales. A sole candidate gets a regret bound from its own best-minus-worst interval. No-eligible early return skips weight/posture validation and hash. NaN weight can be clipped to zero before finite checking; very large finite aggregates can overflow.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D404 Decision scores depend on supplied feasibility and candidate population.md

findings.title: Belief ledger is an ephemeral heuristic rather than canonical truth maintenance
findings.body: Projection excludes revoked/superseded but allows other caller status strings. Support/attack/dependency links affect scores without same-scope checks when all scopes requested; filtered links contribute zero and duplicate links are not deduplicated. Cycles run at most50 iterations. Contradictions remain valid if iteration converges; no evidence resolution or canonical write occurs.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D405 Belief ledger is an ephemeral heuristic rather than canonical truth maintenance.md

findings.title: Structural analogy uses degree and relation summaries without node correspondence
findings.body: Analogy combines relation-label/multiplicity overlap, degree-profile multiset and counts, not graph isomorphism or explicit node mapping. Distinct graphs can share these signatures. Invalid triples and nonmapping candidates can be discarded; a candidate is selected even at zero similarity because there is no abstention threshold.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D406 Structural analogy uses degree and relation summaries without node correspondence.md

findings.title: Reasoning strategy required modes are ranking hints and its plan is not execution
findings.body: Required recognized modes gain100 then remain subject to max_modes truncation; unknown required modes are ignored. Recursive prerequisite expansion can exceed max_modes and introduce evidence, which is not a selectable mode/handler. Generic stop conditions are returned strings. No mode-to-operation translation, payload creation or execution occurs.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D407 Reasoning strategy required modes are ranking hints and its plan is not execution.md

findings.title: Cognitive metadata index construction reads full bodies and trusts merged status
findings.body: Nested index discovery reads each referenced JSON body and may place procedure content into relations; skill description fallback reads entire body. _add unions list fields but first nonempty scalar wins, including first status/title/risk. Missing catalog owner defaults active; missing integration_state in target capability registries becomes admitted. These labels are projection rules, not admission receipts.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D408 Cognitive metadata index construction reads full bodies and trusts merged status.md

findings.title: Cognitive dependency and alias resolution have different ambiguity rules
findings.body: Dependency edges use explicit reviewed mappings or one unique exact/normalized identity, otherwise retain unresolved. Alias-to-leaf helper mapping overwrites normalized collisions before applying aliases. Target project/metacognitive capability records retain dependency/formula fields without creating corresponding edges, so hydration can omit those declarations. Explicit reviewed status is a string, not authenticated review evidence.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D409 Cognitive dependency and alias resolution have different ambiguity rules.md

findings.title: Cognitive index validation does not validate every referenced asset
findings.body: Validator rebuilds and compares index, detects dangling target keys and reports unresolved dependencies without failing them. It does not rehash each supplied body digest, require source/implementation paths to exist/contain root, reject source-edge omissions or validate cycles/status semantics. Tolerant nested JSON readers can skip malformed assets. Standalone builder rebuilds twice then directly overwrites output without atomic publication.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D410 Cognitive index validation does not validate every referenced asset.md

findings.title: Navigator can return unrelated selectable records for a nonmatching query
findings.body: Each selectable record gets+0.25 even without lexical/fuzzy/dense evidence, and only nonpositive total scores are discarded. Thus an unmatched query can produce nondegraded results if such records exist. Selectable includes reference_only/reference/formula, not just admitted/executable; default selectable_only is false. Exact governed alias reason does not prove freshness or authority.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D411 Navigator can return unrelated selectable records for a nonmatching query.md

findings.title: Hydration plan returns unverified paths and incomplete dependency semantics
findings.body: Navigator trusts supplied index revision/records, can hydrate any known key regardless selectable status, and includes no source hash in plan entries. It follows owned_by/depends_on/uses_formula/step edges but omits extends and plain dependency fields lacking edges. It returns valid true with unresolved or truncation and reads no files. Limits bound records, not initial keys or all queued edges.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D412 Hydration plan returns unverified paths and incomplete dependency semantics.md

findings.title: Cognitive CLI run depends on the index even for pure operations
findings.body: CLI loads cognitive_map_index.json before branching into status/query/hydration/run. Status rebuilds/validates index and runs3-family health; query/hydrate trust the loaded index and run still needs it although handler computation uses only the separate input payload. Discovery revision and executable operation evidence are separate boundaries.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D413 Cognitive CLI run depends on the index even for pure operations.md

findings.title: Cognitive trust and reality labels do not resolve evidence
findings.body: TrustEvidence flags are tested for truthiness, confidence against0.6 and text against seven poison substrings. Quarantine is only a returned decision. Reality checks nonempty reference-set inclusion in caller current IDs and contradicted is True; empty claim input can pass. Neither checks content hashes, signatures, current revisions or claim meaning independently.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D414 Cognitive trust and reality labels do not resolve evidence.md

findings.title: Drift and health comparisons lack finite-value guarantees
findings.body: Identity is exact supplied field equality without identity provenance. Personality compares baseline traits only, ignoring extras; NaN differences do not exceed tolerance. Drift assigns missing/mismatched vectors score1, but threshold1 accepts them. EKG NaN values do not trigger comparisons, so a nonfinite metric can appear healthy. These helpers do not collect runtime measurements.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D415 Drift and health comparisons lack finite-value guarantees.md

findings.title: Golden benchmarks execute callbacks without deadline or custody
findings.body: Each runner call actually executes supplied code. Exceptions inside run/comparison become an error name, but actual.encode for hashing is outside that catch and a nonstring return can escape. Unknown match modes fail; duplicate case IDs are not rejected. No case/time/output limit or process lifecycle wrapper is supplied here.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D416 Golden benchmarks execute callbacks without deadline or custody.md

findings.title: Cognitive passport certification is a metadata conjunction
findings.body: Ten component mappings need only be nonempty, so nonempty invalid-status components satisfy presence. Empty trust decisions satisfy the trust condition. Supplied drift and benchmark labels gate certification without current artifact/revision/measurement receipt binding. passport_sha256 binds supplied data but is not a signature or governed certificate.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D417 Cognitive passport certification is a metadata conjunction.md

findings.title: Black-box exclusive files lack sequence and path ownership controls
findings.body: Recorder stores payload_hash, not raw nested payload. runtime_id, event_type and evidence_refs are stored verbatim. Sequence is count of root JSON files plus1 without a shared lock; different event types can concurrently share sequence. Unvalidated event_type becomes part of a path and parent directories are created; separator/dot-segment input can escape intended layout. Exclusive create prevents replacement of one exact path, not authenticated append-only history or containment.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D418 Black-box exclusive files lack sequence and path ownership controls.md

findings.title: Capability genome invalidity does not stop downstream analysis
findings.body: Build reports unknown relation types/endpoints but still computes graph metrics; malformed rows can raise. Duplicate capability IDs are not rejected. dependency_health does not require genome valid and collapses duplicate IDs in a dict. Kahn residual includes nodes blocked downstream from cycles and suppresses the entire topological order. Mutation plan treats outputs from any status as available and emits string-only candidate IDs without implementing or validating them.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D419 Capability genome invalidity does not stop downstream analysis.md

findings.title: Agent profile hard constraints and scores use different caller dimensions
findings.body: Required domains affect a score unless a domain_fit minimum is supplied; unknown requirement keys are ignored unless included in weights. estimated_cost is the hard budget field, while cost is a normalized scoring field. Weights/penalties have no finite/nonnegative validation; a negative calibration penalty boosts rank. Missing agent ID can yield selected_agent None with abstained false.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D420 Agent profile hard constraints and scores use different caller dimensions.md

findings.title: Team composition rewards additional failure labels and lacks aggregate budgets
findings.body: After primary selection, compose_team adds a candidate when its known_failure_modes are not a subset of the accumulated failures. This grows failure-label coverage, not proven complementary success. Duplicate IDs resolve back to first matching profile. max_agents zero or negative can still select the first candidate because limit checks follow append. Each profile passes individual budgets only; team aggregate cost/risk is not evaluated and no agents run.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D421 Team composition rewards additional failure labels and lacks aggregate budgets.md

findings.title: Introspection validates selected shape rather than causal evidence
findings.body: Event IDs must be unique but whitespace is accepted; timestamps and summaries require presence, not parsed time/typed contents. Timeline sorts timestamp text, which need not match instant order across offsets. Decision references need only be nonempty, not resolve to events. Invalid traces still produce summaries and compare_alternatives drops valid/errors. No trace capture, authenticated event order or outcome validation occurs.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D422 Introspection validates selected shape rather than causal evidence.md

findings.title: Invalid practice events still influence derived and transferred patterns
findings.body: Profiler records prohibited fields as violations but keeps rows in pattern aggregation. successful is bool-coerced, so nonempty false-like strings count true. Repeated event IDs are not independent observations; min_observations zero can divide by zero. Only the first three example slots are retained before filtering absent references. compare_profiles ignores source/target valid flags and can suggest patterns derived from invalid profiles.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D423 Invalid practice events still influence derived and transferred patterns.md

findings.title: Metacognitive epistemic state is independent binary updating
findings.body: Each hypothesis receives sequential supplied likelihood updates with no dependence correction or cross-hypothesis normalization. Entropy normalizes posterior weights, which does not turn them into an exclusive hypothesis model. Without evidence, prior is returned without clamp. Brier/ECE helpers lack probability/outcome bounds; nonpositive bins produce ECE0 and out-of-range predictions can be omitted. Common math helpers do not require finite numbers.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D424 Metacognitive epistemic state is independent binary updating.md

findings.title: Contradiction detection compares exact subjects values and a narrow negation form
findings.body: Claims group by exact subject without scope/time/provenance handling. A different non-None value or normalized statement equal to not plus the other statement yields unresolved pair. No semantic entailment, unit conversion, evidence ranking or contradiction resolution occurs. All pair combinations are examined without a budget.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D425 Contradiction detection compares exact subjects values and a narrow negation form.md

findings.title: Knowledge dynamics mixes decayed entropy with original-trust disagreement
findings.body: simulate computes effective_trust from age and half-life for entropy but contradiction_pressure reads each record original trust. Thus time decay need not reduce contradiction pressure. Relations are unvalidated coexecution pairs, including missing IDs stringified None, and attractor strength is summed caller weight. Stability/priorities are fixed weighted formulas with no calibration evidence or persistence.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D426 Knowledge dynamics mixes decayed entropy with original-trust disagreement.md

findings.title: Optimization recommendations can bypass intended checks through malformed numeric policy
findings.body: Unknown direction strings bypass threshold and regression branches but dominate/utility treat them as minimize. NaN metrics evade less/greater threshold and regression checks and can remain Pareto candidates. Empty directions retain all candidates and can still select by utility/ID order. Rollback and independent-validation fields are constant requirements, not performed operations. No collection/time budget or identity/provenance check exists.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D427 Optimization recommendations can bypass intended checks through malformed numeric policy.md

findings.title: Semantic lint checks declarations and selected prefixes only
findings.body: Required list containers are type-checked but elements are not; unhashable rows or nonstring observed effects can raise. Undeclared effects are rejected only for selected sensitive prefixes, using exact write membership rather than hierarchy. Concrete rollback requires only a truthy method; rollback.required false produces warning. Evidence arrays and observed effects are caller declarations, not admission or runtime interception.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D428 Semantic lint checks declarations and selected prefixes only.md

findings.title: Theory clusters use connected similarity rather than universal shared mechanism
findings.body: Signatures merge tokens across mechanisms/formulas/inputs/outputs/failure_modes/invariants, losing field roles. Similarity-connected components can join dissimilar endpoints and have empty all-member intersection. Duplicate IDs collapse records. Cluster IDs include only first two sorted members and can remain unchanged as membership grows. Threshold is unbounded and all pairs are retained.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D429 Theory clusters use connected similarity rather than universal shared mechanism.md

findings.title: Theory admission flag counts supplied held-out pass values
findings.body: validate_proposal bool-coerces case passed and only requires some cases, caller minimum pass rate and truthy distinctness_evidence. It does not execute cases, bind them to proposal identity, enforce independence or validate failure-boundary/operational-value requirements returned by induce. Output reads proposal_id while induced cluster uses cluster_id, requiring an explicit conversion. admit does not publish a theory.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D430 Theory admission flag counts supplied held-out pass values.md

findings.title: Metacognitive facade valid does not mean every domain recommendation succeeded
findings.body: Missing result.valid defaults true, so admit false, abstained true or retain_baseline can accompany wrapper valid true. Only KeyError/TypeError/ValueError are caught around handler; ZeroDivisionError and hashing errors can escape. Fixed denominator and ID-set checks do not establish duplicate-free bijection, implementation/formula correctness or executed workflows. Sixteen operations are explicit payload-only analyses.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D431 Metacognitive facade valid does not mean every domain recommendation succeeded.md

findings.title: Cognitive assurance integration is demonstrated by tests rather than a production owner
findings.body: Repository Python caller search finds cognitive_assurance function definitions and test imports/calls; registry-builder ownership and a reference candidate string do not call the helpers. Tests compose successful passport inputs and selected poison/drift/redaction failures. Metacognitive tests cover basic facade dispatch/denominators and selected validation, not all sixteen operation branches or newly identified numerical/order cases. This report reads tests without running them.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D432 Cognitive assurance integration is demonstrated by tests rather than a production owner.md

findings.title: Behavioral probe validation does not prevent effects or enforce a deadline
findings.body: Duplicate IDs, missing control roles and invalid role labels accumulate reasons but every callback still runs. max_latency_ms is evaluated after invoke and compare complete, so it cannot stop a hanging callback. If all declared oracles have identical repr, discriminating is true even for constant output. Observed successful outputs are retained raw; only exception details are reduced to type.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D433 Behavioral probe validation does not prevent effects or enforce a deadline.md

findings.title: Attribution confidence and coverage demand are supplied-data heuristics
findings.body: attribute_failure prioritizes fixed confidence constants over caller boolean signals; it performs no retrieval or probe. Coverage frontier groups exact normalized ASCII tokens, not semantic clusters; representative text remains and normalization is not redaction. Prioritization can accept nonfinite normalized values through less/greater checks and accepts nonboolean regression/safety inputs. Neither function permits mutation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D434 Attribution confidence and coverage demand are supplied-data heuristics.md

findings.title: Lineage and six-axis gates have separate unchecked policy inputs
findings.body: Lineage checks exact origin/authority/visibility labels and nonempty source_refs without authenticating them; omitted authority/visibility can avoid rejection. assurance_score rejects NaN axis values through range checks but does not validate minimum_axis, so NaN or negative threshold can bypass intended minimums. Numeric string axes can pass float range checking yet fail the later raw-value comparison.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D435 Lineage and six-axis gates have separate unchecked policy inputs.md

findings.title: Behavioral delta certificate does not prove an executed improvement
findings.body: Cases require unique nonblank IDs, expected candidate equality and lowercase SHA shape. Negative-trigger and hard-gate cases must return deny-like labels, but positive coverage is optional, equal baseline/candidate hashes are allowed and changed_case_count may be zero. A positive case with both decisions omitted can pass equality. Evidence hashes are not resolved and the certificate digest is unkeyed.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D436 Behavioral delta certificate does not prove an executed improvement.md

findings.title: Shadow containment and kill switch describe already supplied results
findings.body: compare_shadow_behavior receives completed results, not executable functions. It labels effects contained when caller strings are a subset of read_local/isolated_compute; it does not observe effects or stop a candidate. Kill switch suppresses candidate comparison/hash after result production has already happened elsewhere. Incumbent always returns and authority_granted stays false.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D437 Shadow containment and kill switch describe already supplied results.md

findings.title: Coverage gate trusts summary counts and suffix path matching
findings.body: Validator trusts num_branches/missing_branches without nonnegative or missing<=total checks; zero total gives100percent. An empty class/module policy can pass. It matches exact or suffix module paths rather than source hashes, and accepts any nonempty context name somewhere in the file. Aggregated class coverage can hide a poorly covered module; per-module floors are not imposed.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D438 Coverage gate trusts summary counts and suffix path matching.md

findings.title: Coverage policy errors and class validity can diverge
findings.body: Class valid depends only on complete module matches and aggregate percentage; missing dynamic contexts can make overall valid false while the class still reports valid true. Exemptions are shape-checked and counted, not applied to branch totals. Coverage and policy are read again for hashing after evaluation, so concurrent mutation can bind different bytes from those evaluated. Release caller adds report generation and release-root/hash checks, but helper alone does not prove execution.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D439 Coverage policy errors and class validity can diverge.md

findings.title: Foundation contract compatibility is asymmetric and supplied
findings.body: Only consumer required_fields are compared for presence/type. Provider required_fields, consumer optional fields and consumer ownership are not checked; empty sides can be compatible and unconsumed providers are informational. Authorization sets must match because either-direction differences create findings. Runtime surface plans validate ID/owner/check labels but allow duplicate surface IDs or no checks and execute nothing.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D440 Foundation contract compatibility is asymmetric and supplied.md

findings.title: Retrieval readiness binds result summaries rather than the complete evaluation policy
findings.body: Readiness correctly rejects duplicate top-k results, absent relevance judgments and observed forbidden IDs. However it materializes full result sequences before slicing; leakage beyond k is outside scope. evaluation_sha256 includes rows/metrics but excludes threshold values, full judgments and actual ranked IDs. Identical summary hash can therefore accompany different readiness decisions. activation_allowed is a returned recommendation, not a backend activation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D441 Retrieval readiness binds result summaries rather than the complete evaluation policy.md

findings.title: Dataset admission is metadata-only and does not require split diversity
findings.body: TrainingRecord gate validates hash shape, allowed license/consent strings and cross-split same-content/subject overlaps. It does not fetch source bytes or approval evidence, require train/validation/test presence or prohibit duplicate content within a single split. minimum_records is unvalidated; zero can allow empty metadata. Dataset hash excludes allowed-license policy and threshold.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D442 Dataset admission is metadata-only and does not require split diversity.md

findings.title: Numerical and dimensional foundation helpers have narrower guarantees
findings.body: Numeric shift rejects nonfinite series but does not require a finite threshold; NaN threshold can suppress drift and finite large values may overflow intermediate variance. For nonconstant baseline it measures only mean shift, not changed variance/distribution. Dimension checks int-coerce exponents before algebra, so fractional exponents can be truncated; steps are independent declarations, not linked to an expression or units.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D443 Numerical and dimensional foundation helpers have narrower guarantees.md

findings.title: Provider suite performs effects before guarded probes and lacks disposal
findings.body: Factory calls and initial local.put occur outside _probe exception handling. Factories may start services or mutate stores; suite provides no timeout, ownership registration, close/finally or rollback and retains synthetic data. The foreign root is derived as a sibling of configured root. shared_process/source_of_truth flags are checked, but other isolation properties depend on actual factory behavior.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D444 Provider suite performs effects before guarded probes and lacks disposal.md

findings.title: Provider negative probes can certify weak or empty behavior
findings.body: Prompt-log checks pass with empty logs; correction check only proves old value absent from search and can pass when search always returns empty, without proving corrected value retrievable. Global-slot probe compares configured namespace strings and Python object identity, not real process/storage separation. foreign_write_denied actually writes through foreign instance and checks local value unchanged. Tests use an in-memory fake and typed failure injection.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D445 Provider negative probes can certify weak or empty behavior.md

findings.title: Provider certificate identity excludes publication metadata and actual observations
findings.body: Probe observed_sha256 hashes name/pass/error label, not provider response details. Certificate ID hashes provider/version/config/tests but excludes executed_utc, harness_version, project_id as a separate field, decision and later evidence_refs; config hash includes project indirectly. Optional JSON is exclusive but unkeyed, without independent verifier or backend artifact identity. Returned certified_accelerator does not install or activate a provider.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D446 Provider certificate identity excludes publication metadata and actual observations.md

findings.title: Change proof classification is lexical metadata and has precedence traps
findings.body: Paths are stripped and slash-normalized without resolving dot segments or verifying a diff. Marker substrings such as version can raise unrelated files to release critical. Authority/schema paths return before declared effects, so effects do not always produce the higher RUNTIME class. Malformed non-list symbols/effects are silently treated empty. Upward override verifies hash shape and nonempty approver/rationale but does not retrieve evidence.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D447 Change proof classification is lexical metadata and has precedence traps.md

findings.title: Assurance test names do not establish end-to-end integration
findings.body: Behavioral tests demonstrate callbacks, fixed attribution, lineage labels and average gating. Foundation tests pass synthetic contracts/results/datasets; provider tests use a fake backend. Coverage fixtures supply generated-looking counts and test certificate byte tampering. Python caller search finds actual CLI attribution/score, clean-room delta/shadow dispatch and release coverage generation, but no production run_behavioral_probe or provider-isolation owner.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D448 Assurance test names do not establish end-to-end integration.md

findings.title: Runtime startup and exit helpers have limited authority
findings.body: runtime package import sets sys.dont_write_bytecode globally; runtime.__main__ invokes CLI main. Exit mapping recognizes a closed set and otherwise uses fallback_valid. Platform support checks exact major.minor membership in supplied policy rather than interpreting python_requires; empty version falls back to interpreter. Runtime VERSION is0.7.0 in this source snapshot, not independently verified marketplace state.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D449 Runtime startup and exit helpers have limited authority.md

findings.title: Generic instrumentation preserves caller identity and timestamps across lifecycle variants
findings.body: SDK deep-copies payload and changes lifecycle/result only, retaining event_id, time and previous hash. A caller emitting variants directly to bus must refresh identity/linking itself; RuntimeLifecycle separately uses UUIDs. Started emission happens before try, failed emission can mask original exception, and completed-emission failure follows successful body execution. No effect observation or actor authorization occurs.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D450 Generic instrumentation preserves caller identity and timestamps across lifecycle variants.md

findings.title: Route certifiable is a declaration check rather than current operating readiness
findings.body: Route validator checks schema, ID uniqueness, A/B/C mechanism pairing and blind-spot labels. It does not check consent, active status, health, owner files or evidence content, and Tier D mechanism none is enforced only by deeper reconciliation. Event capture authorization is a classification string, not a verified grant; schema permits nonempty event IDs without safe path syntax and does not correlate lifecycle/result/timing/effects.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D451 Route certifiable is a declaration check rather than current operating readiness.md

findings.title: Bus publication trusts state and route metadata before extending history
findings.body: publish recovers WAL and reads state but does not invoke head or replay before appending. It checks route ID/tier while ignoring route status, consent, effect classes and component/owner identity. Registry is validated then reread, cached by size/mtime/ctime. Event IDs may repeat and receipt path is built from raw ID, so existing receipts can be replaced and dot segments can target other paths within the WAL allowed root. WAL containment does not imply receipt-namespace confinement.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D452 Bus publication trusts state and route metadata before extending history.md

findings.title: Operational batches are sequential commits rather than atomic ingress
findings.body: publish_batch caps1000 events then calls publish independently. Later invalid input leaves earlier events committed, and concurrent publishers can interleave between batch members. CLI caps ingress bytes and overwrites previous hash using link_current_head; this authenticates local chain placement, not the external event producer. There is no cross-event lifecycle or unique event-ID guard.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D453 Operational batches are sequential commits rather than atomic ingress.md

findings.title: Head and replay have different integrity and concurrency limits
findings.body: head holds publish lock, recovers WAL and validates current anchor/state/event plus preceding event digest, not complete ancestry. replay recovers without publish lock, scans all events and can race publication. If no event files exist, replay skips state/head consistency even with nonzero state; head revision0 checks head presence but not orphan event files. Anchors are unkeyed local JSON rather than an external trust root.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D454 Head and replay have different integrity and concurrency limits.md

findings.title: Replay output limits and subscriptions do not bound all work or guarantee all deltas
findings.body: replay reads/retains full history before selecting records after cursor and taking the latest limit; it does not indicate omitted earlier deltas. limit0 still scans history. wait_for_revision uses an instance-local condition, so another instance/process cannot wake it and new state may be observed only at timeout. Full replay cost follows the timeout and is not included in it.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D455 Replay output limits and subscriptions do not bound all work or guarantee all deltas.md

findings.title: Runtime lifecycle wrapper has incomplete terminal traces and declared observations
findings.body: Wrapper emits plan/orchestration/workflow/task starts before checking approved truthiness. Denial or execution failure closes only task/approval or tool/task, leaving parent starts open. verify exceptions are outside execution catch and leave verification started. Successful tool event copies declared_effects to observed_effects; no sensor validates them. Cached previous head races other publishers, and publication failure can follow completed callback effects. No production RuntimeLifecycle caller was found in runtime/scripts search.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D456 Runtime lifecycle wrapper has incomplete terminal traces and declared observations.md

findings.title: Operational coverage hashes receipts without checking their semantic claims
findings.body: A/B advertised routes require healthy supplied state, timezone freshness and matching local receipt SHA. Receipt contents need not name route, state, observation time, kind or current owner revision. Accepted card artifacts need status accepted and matching bytes, but are not tied to each route requirement beyond card prefix. Tier C needs no current health state. valid describes input integrity while certifiable also requires no blockers.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D457 Operational coverage hashes receipts without checking their semantic claims.md

findings.title: Coverage read bounds and identities are not one immutable evidence snapshot
findings.body: JSON size is checked by stat before full read, and health file is fully hashed before the bounded loader. Evidence glob is fully sorted before1000 cap; artifact hashes stream arbitrary total bytes. Hash and parse passes can observe different contents, registry validates then reloads and is hashed later. Linked card JSON paths are not independently resolved below root before load. Unknown/duplicate health routes fail input validity, while stale receipts are operational blockers.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D458 Coverage read bounds and identities are not one immutable evidence snapshot.md

findings.title: External owner evidence is a portable assertion rather than current external-file verification
findings.body: Extension/MCP missing owners may be satisfied by an accepted local receipt with exact owner-path key and SHA shape. The external root need only be a nonempty string; actual external bytes, receipt producer, timestamp and result are not verified. Planned unadvertised routes skip acceptance validation, so such receipts can be considered without that hash-validation path. Local owner checks hash current bytes but do not prove those bytes implement the route.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D459 External owner evidence is a portable assertion rather than current external-file verification.md

findings.title: Host startup attribution has bounded-tail and cache-identity qualifications
findings.body: Selects lexically newest of64 session directories, then latest Codex log with exthost file, without first proving start marker exists. Reads up to16MiB tail by initial size, but growth after stat can exceed it. Main/gateway truncation is not included in log_tail_truncated and their stats are omitted from cache fingerprint. Times are host-local without offsets and marker order is observational; output explicitly refuses causal PX cost or first-tool-readiness claims.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D460 Host startup attribution has bounded-tail and cache-identity qualifications.md

findings.title: Skill host boundary and projection agreement do not inspect every skill body
findings.body: Global SKILL.md paths are recursively enumerated without a cap. facade_only checks10–20 directories and px- prefixes, not body semantics. Skill integrity compares ID sets of index/catalog/directories/package filenames after index validation; it does not compare each package body or status, and set conversion hides duplicate catalog IDs. Direct host-global selection remains explicitly outside PX enforcement.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D461 Skill host boundary and projection agreement do not inspect every skill body.md

findings.title: Frozen benchmark profile is a mutable hash-bearing declaration
findings.body: freeze returns shallow nested structures with hashes, not immutable storage, and cold environment rules are enforced only by subsequent verify. verify checks sections/lane/hash/retry but omits freeze schema_version/run_id/enabled checks; self-rehashed malformed profiles can pass some consumers. Comparison intentionally removes enabled/capabilities/run_id, so distinct enabled capability sets share comparison treatment identity. No environment or oracle observation occurs.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D462 Frozen benchmark profile is a mutable hash-bearing declaration.md

findings.title: Benchmark preflight retry and contamination are caller-policy decisions
findings.body: Preflight requires selected flags is True, but callers can replace required_checks with empty sequence. Retry uses completed_attempts and declared retryable classes without durable attempt accounting or retry execution. Cold contamination accepts any treatment_visibility except exact visible; noncold lanes bypass contamination restrictions. Test-only admission treats every scope string except exact test_only as normal.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D463 Benchmark preflight retry and contamination are caller-policy decisions.md

findings.title: Matched summaries do not pair trial identities or enforce frozen treatment
findings.body: Task sets and per-task row counts must match, but run/trial IDs, environment hashes and comparison profiles are absent. Duplicate rows satisfy counts. Infrastructure-error rows remain in pass-rate denominator. Optional metrics can have different sample denominators and lack finite checks. Strict passed is True avoids truthy strings; result explicitly claims no statistical significance.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D464 Matched summaries do not pair trial identities or enforce frozen treatment.md

findings.title: Benchmark sealed and valid claim labels are not independent custody proof
findings.body: build_custody_record reads full supplied paths or bytes and hashes them plus arbitrary aggregate, returning sealed true even for empty artifacts or run ID. No filesystem seal, signature, atomic snapshot or aggregate-to-artifact relationship is created. Claim labels trust supplied booleans and can call a result controlled uplift without observing actual delta; external comparability is a separate flag.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D465 Benchmark sealed and valid claim labels are not independent custody proof.md

findings.title: Operational tests establish selected source-level contracts rather than observed whole-system closure
findings.body: SDK test compares one Python/Node fixture. Bus tests exercise ordered publish, same-instance wake, selected tampering and CLI ingress; lifecycle tests cover success, callback exception and approval denial. Coverage tests validate synthetic hashes/freshness/external owner declarations. Host tests use synthetic log markers; benchmark tests use supplied results. Cross-process wake, empty-history nonzero state, duplicate IDs, verifier exceptions and semantic receipt contents are not covered by these source tests.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D466 Operational tests establish selected source-level contracts rather than observed whole-system closure.md

findings.title: Classified JSON containment is enforced only on the corrupt-authority path
findings.body: load_classified_json loads/validates caller path before any allowed-root check; successful files and derived-corruption results can be outside allowed root. Optional validator TypeError/ValueError is treated as corrupt state, even if caused by validator logic. No production caller found in runtime/scripts search; registry owner existence does not wire this loader into every state store.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D467 Classified JSON containment is enforced only on the corrupt-authority path.md

findings.title: Authoritative quarantine snapshots are not bound to the bytes that failed parsing
findings.body: After parse failure, quarantine takes two snapshots and a third immediate snapshot but does not compare them to original parsed bytes. A repaired file arriving before those snapshots can be moved as corrupt. Resolving source/quarantine before link checks can erase original symlink spelling. Registry artifact_kind joins destination directories without identifier validation; no final destination containment check follows that join.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D468 Authoritative quarantine snapshots are not bound to the bytes that failed parsing.md

findings.title: Authoritative quarantine detects post-move identity changes but requires explicit recovery
findings.body: Intent is exclusively written/fsynced before os.replace. Destination snapshot must match size/mtime/device/inode/hash; mismatch or final receipt failure retains custody and tries recovery receipt, falling back to intent if recovery write fails. There is no rollback or recovery executor here. Destination-existence check and replacement are separate; no shared lock closes producer/path races. Tests exercise identity swap and final receipt failure.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D469 Authoritative quarantine detects post-move identity changes but requires explicit recovery.md

findings.title: Intake full-tree snapshots actually identify regular-file projections
findings.body: snapshot_tree records files only, hashes whole files after separate stat and omits empty directories, links as links, device/inode and permissions. File symlinks can be followed and enumeration/read work has no count/byte bound. Equality is therefore file-projection identity, not full filesystem snapshot or a lock against concurrent changes.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D470 Intake full-tree snapshots actually identify regular-file projections.md

findings.title: Intake sequence and reopen semantics have gaps
findings.body: Exclusive filenames include sequence plus event kind, so concurrent different event kinds can occupy the same sequence and later fail sequence validation. Events have no hash chain or authentication. close_intake chooses the last two snapshot events over entire history, not since latest open/reopen or matching alias, so unchanged prior-epoch snapshots can satisfy closure. Only actor string presence is checked; nonfinite stability window is not rejected.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D471 Intake sequence and reopen semantics have gaps.md

findings.title: Closed intake movement can complete before failing without a journal
findings.body: The dedicated move helper performs repeated file equality checks then mkdir/shutil.move and post-move snapshot. It has no intent journal, failure compensation or recovery receipt; an existing source manifest name is discovered only after move when exclusive manifest creation fails. Destination-inside-source is not explicitly rejected, and destination existence can change between check and shutil.move. No quarantine event updates the intake ledger.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D472 Closed intake movement can complete before failing without a journal.md

findings.title: Explicit-path wrapper has a file-shape heuristic and independent final publication
findings.body: Expected hashes treat len(inventory)==1 plus path suffix as a file. An extensionless file instead gains a duplicated basename, while a dotted one-file directory can lose its child name. Backend only compares expected keys that match actual inventory, so mismatched wrapper keys do not prove preplanned identity. Backend provides overlap/journal checks, but wrapper post-check or manifest failure can follow committed movement. Final manifest write is nonexclusive after an earlier existence check.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D473 Explicit-path wrapper has a file-shape heuristic and independent final publication.md

findings.title: Evidence cache reserved revisions can be shadowed by dependency names
findings.body: EvidenceCache.key constructs source/authority/toolchain fields then expands caller dependency_revisions into the same mapping. A dependency named source_revision can replace the explicit source revision, yielding a key that does not bind that argument. Stringified dependency keys can collide too. Values require SHA format, not authoritative freshness or complete dependency inventory.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D474 Evidence cache reserved revisions can be shadowed by dependency names.md

findings.title: Evidence cache immutability applies to blobs rather than key mappings
findings.body: put stores content-addressed blobs but overwrites entries[key], so same revision key can point to a different result. Corrupt/missing manifest often resets to empty, while some malformed shapes/Unicode errors escape. get builds a path from unvalidated manifest digest before integrity checking and locks even reads; no blob size cap exists. Prepared files use atomic replace without fsync or failure cleanup, and blob publication can precede failed manifest write.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D475 Evidence cache immutability applies to blobs rather than key mappings.md

findings.title: Durable goal blocker repetition cannot accumulate from refused transitions
findings.body: block requires three consecutive matching history entries, but failed first/second block attempts are not appended because history is updated only when event_applied. Normal returned-state reuse therefore cannot reach blocked without preexisting caller-injected history. Block and complete do not require an in-progress source; supplied acceptance truthiness/nonempty evidence can complete planned or already complete state. No state hash or history integrity is verified.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D476 Durable goal blocker repetition cannot accumulate from refused transitions.md

findings.title: Goal budget and specification closure do not prove durable acceptance
findings.body: continuation_cost is subtracted on every applied event, but budget exhaustion is checked only for continue. Other events may yield negative remaining budget. Specification requires all stage names and earlier references, but can skip adjacent-stage lineage and acceptance need not depend on implementation evidence. Evidence hash is truthiness only. closure_sha256 hashes aggregate counts/errors, not supplied artifact IDs/dependencies/content. Neither helper persists state or grants authority.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D477 Goal budget and specification closure do not prove durable acceptance.md

findings.title: Artifact reachability labels are generated declarations not observed call paths
findings.body: Registry files receive release_validated and default structural owner by filename table. Workflow entrypoint/mode comes from binding strings; duplicate binding keys collapse and targets are not resolved/executed. Agency assets are classified by directory pattern. Structural audit compares rebuilt inventory, which establishes projection freshness rather than runtime reachability.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D478 Artifact reachability labels are generated declarations not observed call paths.md

findings.title: Reachability exclusions avoid digest cycles but do not bound traversal
findings.body: Static inventory intentionally omits live completion/evidence/test-group/world/ledger/engine projections to avoid hash cycles. Root YAML globs and registry/provider traversals enumerate and hash files before record filters external-environment paths, so exclusion does not prevent all I/O to ignored trees. No global file/byte cap or link identity check exists. Standalone builder directly overwrites output without atomic publication or independent validation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D479 Reachability exclusions avoid digest cycles but do not bound traversal.md

findings.title: State and intake tests leave important lifecycle branches unproved
findings.body: Authoritative tests cover corruption preservation, snapshot mismatch, post-move identity swap and receipt failure. Cache tests cover revision change and blob corruption only. Intake tests cover two snapshots and drift, while closed-intake/path wrappers cover simple moves and selected boundary rejection. No source test here covers reopened epoch reuse, concurrent different event kinds, existing manifest collision, reserved cache revision names or goal block accumulation through returned state. No product operations were run.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D480 State and intake tests leave important lifecycle branches unproved.md

findings.title: Proposal digest is sanitized identity, not source identity
findings.body: Sanitization redacts/stringifies keys and values before hashing; collisions can discard distinctions, and recursive collections lack depth/cycle limits. Bounded lists are fully materialized before size rejection.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D481 Proposal digest is sanitized identity, not source identity.md

findings.title: Proposal writer does not authenticate or exclusively publish envelope
findings.body: Writer checks IDs and candidate/nonactivating flags but not proposal_digest or promotion requirements. Existing-file check precedes ordinary write, leaving overwrite race and partial-write exposure.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D482 Proposal writer does not authenticate or exclusively publish envelope.md

findings.title: Skill gap is relative to caller registry rows
findings.body: One supplied provides superset blocks even inactive records; combined coverage is not considered. The candidate contains metadata, not an implemented skill or resolved evidence.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D483 Skill gap is relative to caller registry rows.md

findings.title: Workflow currentness and budget are caller declarations
findings.body: Active/admitted, failed default zero and evidence current label qualify contracts without receipts. Int-converted negative cost/time contributions can lower estimates; these are not runtime enforcement.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D484 Workflow currentness and budget are caller declarations.md

findings.title: Effect subset can suppress proposed approval gates
findings.body: Requested nonempty effects may be a subset of the capability declaration; approval gates derive from that subset. Structural validation checks known effects but does not prove capability implementation omits other declared mutations.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D485 Effect subset can suppress proposed approval gates.md

findings.title: Adapter can omit a required target field
findings.body: Mapping validation accepts optional source to required target of matching type. Transform skips absent optional source and never validates resulting target, so required output can be absent. Source-derived branch finding, not executed reproduction.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D486 Adapter can omit a required target field.md

findings.title: Repair quarantine is a heuristic proposal label
findings.body: Snippet regex checks selected spellings only and can match comments while missing aliases. Original snippet hash may differ from sanitized retained snippet. No file move or code execution follows.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D487 Repair quarantine is a heuristic proposal label.md

findings.title: Proposed test evidence does not run tests
findings.body: passed is evaluated by truthiness, so a nonempty string counts as passed. Required kinds and sanitized digest do not prove observed results, current receipts or admission readiness.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D488 Proposed test evidence does not run tests.md

findings.title: Domain publication can stop after rewriting earlier owners
findings.body: Generator writes domain body/contracts/helper/package before advancing to later domains and registry projections. Missing directory or later parse/write failure leaves partial state; no journal or compensation is implemented.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D489 Domain publication can stop after rewriting earlier owners.md

findings.title: Domain builder assigns validation counts without running tests
findings.body: Package is active/current; admission sets passed=4, failed=0. Owner/workflow/build receipt remains not verified, while already implemented_verified cards survive target rewriting. Status consumers must preserve these different proof scopes.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D490 Domain builder assigns validation counts without running tests.md

findings.title: Generated body and routing namespaces differ
findings.body: Body creation/hash uses .agents/skills; catalog body, references and implementation targets use .px/skills. Generator does not synchronize those trees, so another projection owner is required. Catalog replacement also assumes exact block formatting.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D491 Generated body and routing namespaces differ.md

findings.title: Support schemas and callable registry are declarations
findings.body: Top-level schema is closed and required, but objects/array members remain broad. Callable strings and producer/consumer ownership labels are emitted without resolution or instance execution. Generic input cases repeat across outcomes.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D492 Support schemas and callable registry are declarations.md

findings.title: Support generator writes certified and provisional status together
findings.body: Pack index says implemented_and_certified before QA says operational tests pending and certification says provisional. No test/certifier call exists in builder; hashes include only owner body/package, excluding generated support corpus.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D493 Support generator writes certified and provisional status together.md

findings.title: Semantic index CLI publication is caller-directed and nonatomic
findings.body: Output joined to resolved root can be absolute or traverse parents. No output parent creation, staged replacement or postwrite validation is performed by this wrapper.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D494 Semantic index CLI publication is caller-directed and nonatomic.md

findings.title: Builder tests do not establish generated runtime integration
findings.body: Wave5 fixtures cover proposal helpers and sequential duplicate write; build-support checks strings/schema fields; integration acceptance directly calls builder and runtime utilities. None execute generated declared-suite publication or certify proposed workflows.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D495 Builder tests do not establish generated runtime integration.md

findings.title: Assimilation safety filtering is based on filenames
findings.body: Three known filenames are rejected and two validation scripts classified separately; other script bodies are copied without semantic analysis. Metacognitive source has global textual import replacement without AST/import validation. No source execution was performed for this report.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D496 Assimilation safety filtering is based on filenames.md

findings.title: Assimilation identity can drift or be overridden
findings.body: Source parse/copy/hash and final inventory are separate reads without frozen snapshot. Formula/knowledge record unpack follows pack/source_sha256 fields and can override them. Workflow matching ignores pack; duplicate IDs collapse in dictionaries.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D497 Assimilation identity can drift or be overridden.md

findings.title: Split contract IDs are used as paths before containment proof
findings.body: Contract IDs are interpolated into JSON targets with no identifier validation; dump writes before relative_to(root) is evaluated. Source-derived traversal risk requires malformed input; not reproduced. Existing .agents/.px namespace split persists.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D498 Split contract IDs are used as paths before containment proof.md

findings.title: Zero open dispositions means classification, not complete assimilation
findings.body: file_ledger assigns implemented_or_retained to every path and open_count=0 without examining intended target existence/content or actual operation receipts. Scheduler engine is labelled admit/harden but integrate_scheduler only imports metadata/schema/reference content.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D499 Zero open dispositions means classification, not complete assimilation.md

findings.title: Assimilation can publish verified recovery labels before pending receipt
findings.body: wire_product sets authoritative_implementation_verified and supplied_and_revalidated without running tests; meta/scheduler admission remains pending. Product writes and derived projections occur before final built_pending_validation receipt. Historical tests expect later verified_complete fields absent from this generator output.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D500 Assimilation can publish verified recovery labels before pending receipt.md

findings.title: Declared plan does not evaluate its authority and recovery prose
findings.body: Plan checks basic target/constraints shape and returns contract steps/failure/recovery/evidence fields. It does not enforce declared effects, evidence freshness, approval, available oracle or rollback capability.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D501 Declared plan does not evaluate its authority and recovery prose.md

findings.title: Script outcome dispatch follows vocabulary rather than exact body
findings.body: Inventory words take precedence, followed by compare/rank/scan/validate/case generation and fallback normalization. Copied implementation_target and authoritative contract do not select execution. Determinism of generic output is not proof of advertised outcome semantics.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D502 Script outcome dispatch follows vocabulary rather than exact body.md

findings.title: Read-only declared helpers have incomplete input and resource bounds
findings.body: Inventory enumerates before count limit and reads whole files at arbitrary resolved target; scan allows empty patterns and unbounded matches. Rank defaults to zero weights, malformed metrics can raise uncaught AttributeError and NaN scores are not rejected.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D503 Read-only declared helpers have incomplete input and resource bounds.md

findings.title: Declared success and count checks have narrow proof scope
findings.body: valid True wraps completed field validation even accepted False. Describe/plan reread mutable registries before catch; missing contract StopIteration escapes. Suite validator checks declared workflow_count62 rather than actual workflow-list length and does not prove behavioral coverage.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D504 Declared success and count checks have narrow proof scope.md

findings.title: Formula range guards do not consistently reject invalid distributions
findings.body: Expected utility only checks probability sum; negative probabilities can cancel. PSI checks sums/length but not nonnegative entries/valid epsilon. Many inequality guards admit NaN; coverage may exceed one or be negative. These are source-inferred input cases, not executed tests.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D505 Formula range guards do not consistently reject invalid distributions.md

findings.title: Formula registry identity and mathematical assumptions remain separate
findings.body: Registry validator checks envelope/count/unique IDs and FORMULAS set equality, not expression/source/callable hashes. Confidence combination assumes independence; duplicate IDs within one ranking repeatedly contribute to RRF. Weighted quality guards quality range but not finite weights.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D506 Formula registry identity and mathematical assumptions remain separate.md

findings.title: Historical assimilation and generic behavior tests leave different gaps
findings.body: Assimilation tests inspect retained labels/paths and one package digest; domain tests run61IDs using one all-purpose payload; support cases test plan shape and selected formula examples. They do not test generator transaction closure or independent semantics of every outcome.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D507 Historical assimilation and generic behavior tests leave different gaps.md

findings.title: Mining receipt does not prove scan-set coverage
findings.body: Report digests are syntax checked, maximum files_accounted assumes overlap, and no source-set union or report content is resolved. Receipt binds admission bytes and count but not workflow/catalog versions.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D508 Mining receipt does not prove scan-set coverage.md

findings.title: Assimilation gate permits empty collections and narrow workflow proof
findings.body: Empty scans/dispositions/workflows can pass with matching zero receipt/hash. Workflow checks identity/selectability/dependencies/cycles, not I-O/effects/budgets. Disposition target presence does not require active catalog status.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D509 Assimilation gate permits empty collections and narrow workflow proof.md

findings.title: Backend selection is independent of catalog validation
findings.body: Missing effects become empty and rank as least effect; status/currentness/health and adapter existence are ignored. Cost is float-converted without finiteness/nonnegative checks; no required domains yields valid empty selection.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D510 Backend selection is independent of catalog validation.md

findings.title: Tool-intake CLI cannot forward required scanner network policy
findings.body: CLI exposes execute-scanners and approve-scanners but neither network argument nor forwarding. scan_project_tooling rejects execution when scanner_network_allowed remains None. Source caller mismatch; no execution attempted.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D511 Tool-intake CLI cannot forward required scanner network policy.md

findings.title: Scanner identity and isolation remain caller-bound
findings.body: Resolved path equality prevents simple path shadowing, but approved executable comes from PATH and no expected content digest is checked before use. Network-denied enforcement is a boolean claim plus environment string; this function does not install isolation. Nonboolean policy values are not strictly rejected.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D512 Scanner identity and isolation remain caller-bound.md

findings.title: Scanner pass means exit zero and parseable JSON
findings.body: Any JSON including scalar/null or findings-bearing object can pass. Structured contents are not retained/interpreted, vulnerabilities remain empty and license UNKNOWN. A caller allowing UNKNOWN can satisfy license condition; ClamAV recipe emits ordinary text incompatible with generic JSON requirement.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D513 Scanner pass means exit zero and parseable JSON.md

findings.title: Scanner digest does not freeze executable or input corpus
findings.body: Corpus digest computed once before sequential scans; no scanner/postscan comparison. Executable hash obtained after version/scan. Captured output is uncapped, timeout applies separately to version and scan, and no resource-lifecycle process-tree owner is used.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D514 Scanner digest does not freeze executable or input corpus.md

findings.title: Intake publication can outlive failed project-state update
findings.body: Intake replace precedes state parse/update/history/replace. Shared fixed .next names, no lock or WAL, and separate history hash/read allow races. Scan occurs before apply/state existence gate; quarantine decision does not physically quarantine tooling.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D515 Intake publication can outlive failed project-state update.md

findings.title: Tool recommendations are bounded signals with incomplete traversal limits
findings.body: File cap stops counting but directory names collected per visited directory are uncapped. Truncation remains valid; later relevant files may be missed. Resolver path is only availability metadata, and approval requests are returned data, not submitted actions.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D516 Tool recommendations are bounded signals with incomplete traversal limits.md

findings.title: Optional search acceleration changes the searchable corpus
findings.body: rg default hidden/ignore/binary rules differ from Python fixed skip set and replacement decoding. Fallback reads symlink files without containment. Leading-option needle lacks -- separator; success may reflect rg option parsing. Both output and fallback file bytes are uncapped.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D517 Optional search acceleration changes the searchable corpus.md

findings.title: Lifecycle verification accepts failed status values
findings.body: tests/verifier are rejected only for specific missing/not_run/incomplete sentinels. Values such as failed or False pass the comparison. Tool/process/change/validation receipt stages check reference or mapping truthiness without resolving evidence.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D518 Lifecycle verification accepts failed status values.md

findings.title: Lifecycle valid differs from commissioned and complete
findings.body: Top-level valid uses framework registry and state parse error, omitting project-management errors. Hard-coded check order drives next stage; graph edges do not. Stage completion is metadata projection rather than successful operation proof.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D519 Lifecycle valid differs from commissioned and complete.md

findings.title: Tool-intake tests cover fake runner contracts rather than real scanners
findings.body: Tests exercise scrubbed environment, path refusal, forwarded digest, timeout and network flag with fake JSON output. No CLI network forwarding, finding semantics, kernel isolation, partial publication or concurrency coverage is shown.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D520 Tool-intake tests cover fake runner contracts rather than real scanners.md

findings.title: Passed repair cards require receipt presence rather than executed proof
findings.body: Nonempty receipts list passes without resolving values, hashes or currentness. Existing test uses synthetic receipt strings. Status vocabulary comes from same ledger; allowed_pending can exempt nonpassed cards at caller boundary.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D521 Passed repair cards require receipt presence rather than executed proof.md

findings.title: Repair dependency and owner checks are structural
findings.body: Dependencies reject unknown/self references but not multi-card cycles or completion order. Resolved owner/test paths may be root/directories because exists, not is_file, is used.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D522 Repair dependency and owner checks are structural.md

findings.title: Root grouping requires exact whole signatures and caller denominator
findings.body: Groups equal evidence/owner/dependency tuples; partially overlapping causes stay separate. Expected duplicates collapse to set and empty IDs are not explicitly rejected. Candidate sequential prefix changes when earlier groups are introduced.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D523 Root grouping requires exact whole signatures and caller denominator.md

findings.title: Discriminating plans do not authenticate analysis or execute tests
findings.body: Plan accepts candidate mapping and copied analysis hash, checks confirmation IDs exist and emits generic oracle text. It does not recompute analysis digest or establish confirmations from observations.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D524 Discriminating plans do not authenticate analysis or execute tests.md

findings.title: Hypothesis independence is a limited artifact check
findings.body: Strict isolated flag and evidence presence are required, but evidence correlation is flagged only when an ID appears in every branch. Pairwise/semantic common origin and artifact digests are not resolved. critic independent is an assigned label.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D525 Hypothesis independence is a limited artifact check.md

findings.title: Panel hash omits convergence policy and always uses one round
findings.body: max_rounds is validated/reported but does not drive repeated critique. Digest binds normalized branches and critic, omitting threshold and therefore whether selected_conclusion is returned. Zero confidence still contributes0.01 weight.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D526 Panel hash omits convergence policy and always uses one round.md

findings.title: Communication repetition can hide differing messages
findings.body: Optional same category/casefold repeat_key keeps first text and unions evidence/source IDs; no text equivalence check. Caller can remove mandatory categories. Input/bytes unbounded; digest excludes dropped corpus. Insufficient budget preserves all mandatory records and reports invalid.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D527 Communication repetition can hide differing messages.md

findings.title: Syntax normalization is narrower than behavioral equivalence
findings.body: JSON/YAML key sorting removes insertion order and duplicate keys collapse. Python AST drops comments/locations though source locations can be observed. Unsupported types retain bytes; supported parse/serialization errors propagate.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D528 Syntax normalization is narrower than behavioral equivalence.md

findings.title: Semantic digest does not include canonicalizer identity
findings.body: Canonicalizer name/revision and artifact type are reported but not hashed with canonical bytes; Python AST/library behavior may vary by runtime version. No production caller found in searched source.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D529 Semantic digest does not include canonicalizer identity.md

findings.title: Build counts measure declared paths and rows
findings.body: Runtime/contracts globs can count matching directories and registry collections count rows regardless selectable/operational state. Only registry artifact count has the full mutable/external exclusions; claims are not a universal file or behavior denominator.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D530 Build counts measure declared paths and rows.md

findings.title: README validation and publication enforce different uniqueness
findings.body: Updater requires exactly one row per label before write; validator reads first matching row and accepts version substring anywhere. Expected fact loading is outside stored-claim error boundary.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D531 README validation and publication enforce different uniqueness.md

findings.title: Build projection can commit one artifact and fail the second
findings.body: Prepared claims file is exclusive and fsynced, but replaced before README update. A later error leaves partial projection; orphan prepared file can block retry. Missing initial claims target changes counted registry size after computation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D532 Build projection can commit one artifact and fail the second.md

findings.title: Repair reasoning and identity tests cover selected helper claims
findings.body: Tests prove exact-signature determinism, basic all-shared evidence rejection and formatting invariance; they do not establish causal roots, independent agents or general behavioral equivalence. Build script ordering test is source-text inspection rather than interruption reproduction.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D533 Repair reasoning and identity tests cover selected helper claims.md

findings.title: Repository context gate checks presence rather than authority content
findings.body: Any existing .git and required is_file paths satisfy this helper. It does not authenticate Git, ledger signatures, processing phase or receipt bytes despite intended authenticated-context role.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D534 Repository context gate checks presence rather than authority content.md

findings.title: Git capture and historical verification have distinct freshness scopes
findings.body: Capture requires annotated tag at HEAD and allowed origin with classified dirty inputs; historical verifier resolves recorded commit/tree/tag but not current HEAD or worktree. Queries are separate and not snapshot-locked. Annotated is not signed.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D535 Git capture and historical verification have distinct freshness scopes.md

findings.title: Version and Git path parsing leave narrower checks than labels imply
findings.body: README regex captures stable versions only, so development comparison cannot enforce exact dev equality and permits absent stable marker. Changed paths are stripped, altering significant whitespace; ignored untracked files are omitted from Git list and need independent product digest coverage.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D536 Version and Git path parsing leave narrower checks than labels imply.md

findings.title: Classifier binds product bytes separately from evidence/control
findings.body: Evidence/control records carry no content hash; suffix/name allowlisting is not payload validation. product_valid excludes nonproduct errors, while valid rejects them. Harness digest is curated subset, not complete transitive implementation closure.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D537 Classifier binds product bytes separately from evidence/control.md

findings.title: Classification hashes can observe different file state than walker metadata
findings.body: Walker establishes size/limits/link policy, then classifier reopens paths for content. Growth can exceed initial byte estimate, disappearance can omit a walked file, and policy is reread for final hash after parsing. No shared source snapshot.
