findings.note: 05 Findings/D538 Classification hashes can observe different file state than walker metadata.md

findings.title: Clean copy has no intrinsic identity or transaction gate
findings.body: copytree filters names at all depths and follows links by default; external directory resolution can fail after partial writes, while file links can copy referenced content. No destination-outside-source guard or postcopy hash in helper. Downstream audit/classifier supplies stronger checks.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D539 Clean copy has no intrinsic identity or transaction gate.md

findings.title: Materialized source receipt retains pre-copy hashes
findings.body: Source classification precedes copies; each selected file is validated just before copying, so later invalid extra/failure leaves prior copies. Receipt returns initial product/harness hashes and counts without comparing destination bytes. Evidence/extras are outside those product hashes.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D540 Materialized source receipt retains pre-copy hashes.md

findings.title: Clean boundary audit intentionally permits source nonproduct errors
findings.body: It requires source product_valid, clean valid, all identity/product inputs and byte/digest equality. It can pass when excluded source evidence is invalid, preserving those errors in result; this is not a clean-source-every-file certificate.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D541 Clean boundary audit intentionally permits source nonproduct errors.md

findings.title: Evidence manifest symlink check follows resolution
findings.body: Paths are resolved before is_symlink, so in-root symbolic links lose their original link identity. Escape remains checked, but alias spellings can reference same bytes under distinct records. Full file reads have no size/stability bound.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D542 Evidence manifest symlink check follows resolution.md

findings.title: Manifest verification needs a separately trusted required denominator
findings.body: Empty evidence list with recomputed self-hash can pass; schema/version/role/generation semantics are not enforced. Optional-missing entries skip verification even if a file later appears. Only selected records covered, and manifest valid/errors fields are outside its digest payload. Certificate caller separately authenticates manifest file.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D543 Manifest verification needs a separately trusted required denominator.md

findings.title: JUnit skip allowlist does not validate full test execution
findings.body: Unnamespaced testcase/skipped traversal and reason substring matching can see no cases in empty/namespaced XML and return valid. Duplicate cases and aggregate totals are not checked. Certification separately uses process exit and JUnit totals.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D544 JUnit skip allowlist does not validate full test execution.md

findings.title: Fixed point measures configured projection subset after first rebuild
findings.body: Only listed authority hashes compared after two rebuilds; absent files hash None and can match, unlisted output changes are ignored, and original source equivalence is separate. Standalone wrapper copies/rebuilds/cleans temp tree without ResourceManager registration.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D545 Fixed point measures configured projection subset after first rebuild.md

findings.title: Release tests demonstrate important integrity checks but not race closure
findings.body: Fixtures test dirty/tag/version rejection, signed-content tamper/revocation, evidence byte changes, exclusions and exact-phase campaign rewinds. They do not freeze file identity across classification/copy or resolve all optional/missing manifest cases. No tests executed for atlas.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D546 Release tests demonstrate important integrity checks but not race closure.md

findings.title: Dry-run and discovery retain projection cache and cleanup effects
findings.body: Both wrappers call run_preflight; write_receipt=False suppresses only main receipt. Static completion projection may write live registry, expensive phases create/rebuild/reclaim workspace and passing results write caches. Dry-run still requires certify processing stage.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D547 Dry-run and discovery retain projection cache and cleanup effects.md

findings.title: Deep discovery stops early and can reuse ordinary stress cache
findings.body: Static loop breaks on first invalid gate; expensive gates require prior success. Deep flag only multiplies concurrency iterations on execution and is absent from cache key. Existing deep test mocks whole orchestration, proving forwarding rather than exhaustive execution.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D548 Deep discovery stops early and can reuse ordinary stress cache.md

findings.title: Preflight cache authenticates inputs only by equality and flags
findings.body: Cached JSON needs valid=True, matching inputs and nested check valid=True, but no result hash/signature or required observation schema. Implementation digest includes three files, not transitive check/lock sources.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D549 Preflight cache authenticates inputs only by equality and flags.md

findings.title: Installed equivalence cache omits actual host receipt identities
findings.body: Key binds engine/manifest/artifact/node and common runtime fields but not installed-smoke receipt bytes or current observations. Unchanged identity can reuse a previously passing result after host evidence changes.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D550 Installed equivalence cache omits actual host receipt identities.md

findings.title: Preflight receipt validator does not require executed check denominator
findings.body: Self-hash and fresh binding are checked with stored valid/ready flags, but checks list, phase completeness, mode and verdict consistency are not revalidated. Existing test accepts a minimal receipt without checks.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D551 Preflight receipt validator does not require executed check denominator.md

findings.title: Returned readiness uses initial binding and may skip fresh boundary
findings.body: Binding captured before static/effectful phases, with no final recapture. Cached clean_boundary bypasses require_stable_source_binding fresh observation. Finalizer receipt validation supplies a later independent rebind, but immediate returned ready can reflect stale initial facts.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D552 Returned readiness uses initial binding and may skip fresh boundary.md

findings.title: Preflight ignores the reclamation result when scoring readiness
findings.body: Owned workspace is ended and reclaim called in finally; returned cleanup receipt is not added to checks. A nonthrowing rejected/failed reclaim can coexist with passing checks and subsequent cache publication.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D553 Preflight ignores the reclamation result when scoring readiness.md

findings.title: Feedback target safety is lexical and policy-relative
findings.body: Audit substitutes placeholders and accepts evidence/runtime prefixes without resolving parent components. Product classification validity is not checked before extracting product paths. It audits declared targets, not observed filesystem effects.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D554 Feedback target safety is lexical and policy-relative.md

findings.title: Evidence portability can read before the configured size gate
findings.body: Static portability precedes budget and reads full selected text. Corpus differs with pyproject presence and only selected suffixes are scanned; NDJSON is omitted though release classifier permits it. Budget uses zero amplification when product bytes are zero.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D555 Evidence portability can read before the configured size gate.md

findings.title: Mutation and rebuild comparison do not prove all effects absent
findings.body: Mutation compares final file content, omitting write-restore, metadata/directories and outside-root effects. Rebuild iterates authorities multiple times; a one-shot generator can be exhausted before comparison, though main caller passes a policy list.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D556 Mutation and rebuild comparison do not prove all effects absent.md

findings.title: Concurrency stress can pass without iterations
findings.body: No positive bound enforced by helper or CLI; zero/negative range executes no competing actors and returns valid. Seed controls delays but OS publication winners are not deterministic. Atomic prepared writes lack fsync and leave prepared file on unrecovered replacement error.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D557 Concurrency stress can pass without iterations.md

findings.title: Preflight transition rows include simulated later lifecycle states
findings.body: Build/install/evidence/certificate transition rows are assembled from artifact argument and simulation results. Preflight does not perform authoritative build/install/sign/publish for these rows. Wrapper schema changes also leave inherited receipt hash referring to original run result.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D558 Preflight transition rows include simulated later lifecycle states.md

findings.title: Named mutation probe selection is unused
findings.body: CLI accepts generated-builders, test-smoke, installed-smoke, dashboard-read and other choices, but ignores args.probe and always invokes only classify_tree/build_engine_identity. Named coverage is not performed by this script.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D559 Named mutation probe selection is unused.md

findings.title: Static gate failure may produce empty blocking-reason list
findings.body: checks_valid fails on false gate, but blocking_reasons collects only failures arrays. Helpers returning errors without failures can stop work while blocking_reasons is empty; summary failed/check details remain necessary.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D560 Static gate failure may produce empty blocking-reason list.md

findings.title: Preflight tests mostly isolate helpers and forwarding seams
findings.body: Tests cover useful drift, exact-artifact hash, projection mismatch, skip and simple concurrency cases. They do not run full orchestration through cache hit/miss, cleanup failure, deep reuse or diagnostic writes; minimal receipt test explicitly lacks check evidence.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D561 Preflight tests mostly isolate helpers and forwarding seams.md

findings.title: Release full-tests drops runner closure and cleanup validity
findings.body: Runner can return exit_code=0, timed_out=False and valid=False for unproven tree closure or unreclaimed workspace. Release full_tests checks exit/timeout/JUnit but ignores valid, process_tree_terminated and test_workspace. Coverage path separately consumes valid.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D562 Release full-tests drops runner closure and cleanup validity.md

findings.title: Certification test root and candidate root are different
findings.body: Default gate runner tests authenticated source with release venv interpreter and certified-wheel environment markers. Candidate is used for other contract/artifact/environment gates. Source test projection refresh can write before execution; clean staged tree is not the sole test corpus.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D563 Certification test root and candidate root are different.md

findings.title: Supply-chain provenance loses Git commit and tree through key mismatch
findings.body: capture_git_identity returns commit_sha/tree_sha. Finalizer passes it unchanged to provenance writer, which reads commit/tree with empty-string defaults. Certificate retains the original fields, but provenance gitCommit/gitTree are empty on this route. SBOM describes artifact files rather than dependency closure.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D564 Supply-chain provenance loses Git commit and tree through key mismatch.md

findings.title: Evidence commit is per-file and can report zero after partial writes
findings.body: Preflight collisions preserve existing files, and xb protects each new file. An OSError after earlier copies returns copied_file_count zero without rollback or reconciliation. Journal is publishing_evidence until complete; this module has no resume consumer.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D565 Evidence commit is per-file and can report zero after partial writes.md

findings.title: Certificate evidence exists before final certification outcome
findings.body: Sign/copy/journal happen under release lock; certificate verification and completion projection happen after lock release. Failed verification or projection can return certified=False while local certificate and evidence remain. published=False is returned even on success: marketplace publication is separate.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D566 Certificate evidence exists before final certification outcome.md

findings.title: Manifest locators have weaker containment than coverage locator
findings.body: Coverage uses resolved release-root containment. Evidence and artifact manifest branches check lexical release prefix plus resolved is_file without relative_to containment; signature path is joined from signed metadata. This is a verifier boundary difference, not a claim that unsigned content bypasses signature checks.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D567 Manifest locators have weaker containment than coverage locator.md

findings.title: Certificate verifier binds bytes but does not replay gate semantics
findings.body: Verifier checks trust/version/Git/current classified digests/coverage/manifests/artifacts/ledger. It does not validate gate-summary required gate denominator or rerun release tests. Signature vouches for publisher assertion; evidence file integrity is not independent behavioral proof.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D568 Certificate verifier binds bytes but does not replay gate semantics.md

findings.title: JUnit summary and case gates use different parsing assumptions
findings.body: Totals aggregate suite attributes with namespace handling, not actual testcase counts. Named marker uses unnamespaced testcase elements and substring matching. Negative/inconsistent totals are not reconciled here; named positive case still required separately.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D569 JUnit summary and case gates use different parsing assumptions.md

findings.title: Portability redaction is a selected textual heuristic
findings.body: Recursive payload traversal checks dictionary values/lists/strings rather than keys or all object types. Regex covers selected machine-local and parent paths, not every absolute POSIX root. JUnit hostname removal and case selection are unnamespaced.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D570 Portability redaction is a selected textual heuristic.md

findings.title: Coverage compaction deliberately reduces attribution evidence
findings.body: Keeps top-level contexts only for configured module suffixes and removes nested function/class contexts everywhere. Uses fixed .compacted replacement without lock/fsync. Result preserves totals but cannot support discarded per-test attribution.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D571 Coverage compaction deliberately reduces attribution evidence.md

findings.title: Release expensive gates are not uniformly fail-fast
findings.body: After test execution, coverage and exact-tool checks can run despite earlier invalid gates; check dictionary eagerly calls audits. Finalizer external quarantine/installed environments and ordinary subprocess calls lack ResourceManager reconciliation in this module.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D572 Release expensive gates are not uniformly fail-fast.md

findings.title: Certification captures identity before acquiring release lock
findings.body: Git/preflight/source/wheelhouse prerequisites are captured before lock. Later frozen comparisons check product/harness rather than recapturing every prior fact. Coverage working database path is based on wheel hash, not unique run ID; separate callers can target same file.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D573 Certification captures identity before acquiring release lock.md

findings.title: Explicit pytest basetemp changes runner custody
findings.body: Any matching pytest token triggers detection; an explicit basetemp disables automatic workspace/temp/key isolation unless manage_process_temp is true. Rootdir/cache/lifecycle plugin injection still occurs. Caller-supplied paths and environment are not equivalent to managed isolation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D574 Explicit pytest basetemp changes runner custody.md

findings.title: Test runner preparation and exception reclamation have separate gaps
findings.body: Workspace/subdirectory/environment/accounting setup occurs before try. Failure there can escape cleanup. BaseException path performs update/reclaim and finally performs it again, potentially masking original exception or duplicating lifecycle attempts depending on manager behavior.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D575 Test runner preparation and exception reclamation have separate gaps.md

findings.title: Inherited test lease helper trusts caller and environment token
findings.body: When allow_inherited_owner and any owner string are present, helper returns without physical lock. It does not check SUPERVISED_CHILD_ENV or root/parent identity. CLI caller eligibility and process environment discipline provide the additional boundary.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D576 Inherited test lease helper trusts caller and environment token.md

findings.title: Fault campaign declared coverage and executed assertions are different
findings.body: Loader proves union of lane dimension labels equals required labels, but does not examine test assertions. Only command first token python/node is admitted; arguments otherwise arbitrary valid strings. Cwd is contained, but authority label does not constrain child effects.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D577 Fault campaign declared coverage and executed assertions are different.md

findings.title: Fault campaign loses partial evidence on timeout and binds inputs afterward
findings.body: All lanes run after nonzero exits, but timeout exceptions abort receipt publication. Captured output is discarded after hashing. Only tests/ argument tokens are hashed, after execution; transitive code, interpreter, policy and in-flight input identity are not bound.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D578 Fault campaign loses partial evidence on timeout and binds inputs afterward.md

findings.title: Certification tests prove selected seams rather than final transaction closure
findings.body: Tests stop finalizer at materialization or missing-input branches; verifier binding test mocks trust/Git/coverage/manifest checks. Evidence copy tests cover ordinary success and existing collision, not mid-copy failure or post-commit invalidation. Runner tests contain real subprocess drills but no current execution was performed.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D579 Certification tests prove selected seams rather than final transaction closure.md

findings.title: Section and group status do not verify their receipt self-hashes
findings.body: Writers seal receipts, but status readers use passed/input_sha256 only. They do not bind receipt section/group/schema or re-evaluate exit/valid. Chunk reader checks exact schema and hash, so these three receipt consumers provide different assurance.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D580 Section and group status do not verify their receipt self-hashes.md

findings.title: Group status can discard stale index signal
findings.body: resolve_test_groups computes index_current and current fingerprint. group_status compares stored receipt to that fingerprint but does not require index_current. A receipt matching changed inputs can report current while stored index is stale. Direct group execution separately rejects index_current false; full-profile/preflight status consumers do not repeat that check.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D581 Group status can discard stale index signal.md

findings.title: Group dependency closure omits relative and dynamic imports
findings.body: Both AST paths process ImportFrom only when level==0 and use module name without imported alias resolution. Module map covers runtime/builders/scripts, omitting tests helpers and conftest. Declared input patterns may compensate but automatic transitive completeness is not established.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D582 Group dependency closure omits relative and dynamic imports.md

findings.title: Generated test index reuses and trusts stored metadata
findings.body: Equal source sha and imports-list shape allow prior imports reuse without recomputing AST. Resolver checks config topology and exact test membership but trusts stored base_inputs and other group fields; stored unpack can override earlier valid. Non-structural newly matching inputs are not rediscovered until rebuild.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D583 Generated test index reuses and trusts stored metadata.md

findings.title: Test profile denominator is top-level Python filenames
findings.body: Profiles/groups glob tests/test_*.py, not recursive tests or JS/extension suites. Other governed sections own additional surfaces. Release uses full exclusions; CLI full/release run replaces resolved member command with current groups plus cross-group command.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D584 Test profile denominator is top-level Python filenames.md

findings.title: Empty required receipt lists are vacuously valid
findings.body: section_status/group_status use all over configured required lists. Missing or empty certification denominator yields true even if rows fail; repository config currently supplies lists, but helpers do not require nonempty or exact set.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D585 Empty required receipt lists are vacuously valid.md

findings.title: Section group and chunk execution validity defaults differ
findings.body: Section/group receipt construction defaults missing execution.valid to true; chunk requires explicit true. All are self-hashed assertions from supplied execution dictionaries. Existing tests intentionally create passing section/group receipts without valid.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D586 Section group and chunk execution validity defaults differ.md

findings.title: Section input paths and temporary publication need caller discipline
findings.body: Section cwd has resolved containment, but source-pattern files are not uniformly resolved-contained or link-rejected. Chunk membership treats any existing non-option command token as a file. Receipt temporary filenames use PID, allowing same-process concurrent collision; no file fsync or local writer lock.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D587 Section input paths and temporary publication need caller discipline.md

findings.title: Bounded failure attribution still contains caller-controlled names
findings.body: Output is hashed and raw bodies omitted, but extracted pytest node IDs, Node/TAP titles are retained up to 50 by 300 characters. Parameterized names can include sensitive values; length limits and stripping assertion tails do not perform general redaction.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D588 Bounded failure attribution still contains caller-controlled names.md

findings.title: Repair phase checking and actual stage claims are separate
findings.body: Phase table blocks closure while intake/unresolved remains. Project marker adds release identity and pending/current claim checks; require_processing_stage does not claim or advance state. Repository campaign is preferred over project state, and roots without campaign/marker are unmanaged.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D589 Repair phase checking and actual stage claims are separate.md

findings.title: CLI narrows inherited test lease to one marked child
findings.body: CLI only permits reuse for test-group run-stale when owner and supervised-child environment values match, then removes child marker. This supplements the permissive lock helper, but values are environment claims rather than OS parent verification.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D590 CLI narrows inherited test lease to one marked child.md

findings.title: Independent gate cache does not bind every executable input
findings.body: Digest includes gate ID, matched file bytes and dependency receipt hashes, not GateSpec definition or runner/toolchain identity by default. Licensing input list omits runtime/licensing.py, third-party license files and several required root files, so those changes may reuse an earlier passing cache.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D591 Independent gate cache does not bind every executable input.md

findings.title: Independent gate receipt integrity is not semantic consistency
findings.body: _load_receipt accepts matching unkeyed hash. Run/finalize trust passed and input hash without requiring nested result.valid or expected schema/gate identity. Malformed nonobject JSON may escape because TypeError/AttributeError are not uniformly caught.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D592 Independent gate receipt integrity is not semantic consistency.md

findings.title: Independent gate ordering and publication assume fixed registry
findings.body: Run recurses dependencies without explicit cycle guard; finalize assumes registry insertion order supplies dependencies first. Direct receipt overwrite has no transaction/lock/fsync, and fingerprint is captured before callback only. CLI lock selector does not include gates surface.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D593 Independent gate ordering and publication assume fixed registry.md

findings.title: Licensing consistency does not authenticate every attribution body
findings.body: Validator exact-hashes main LICENSE, but fixed third-party files only require presence and NOTICE markers; reported hashes are not compared to expected bodies. Missing README is not itself a required-root failure. This is configured metadata consistency, not legal sufficiency or exhaustive dependency licensing.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D594 Licensing consistency does not authenticate every attribution body.md

findings.title: Licensing report checks relative location after writing
findings.body: Caller can supply absolute destination; writer creates parents and writes report before relative_to(root) is evaluated for returned locator. Outside-root destination therefore can receive bytes before ValueError. CLI default uses repository evidence path.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D595 Licensing report checks relative location after writing.md

findings.title: Gate and test-profile tests leave consumer asymmetries uncovered
findings.body: Tests cover useful input drift, failed-gate rerun, strict chunk receipt tamper, structural inventory drift and phase order. They do not assert section/group hash verification, relative-import closure, stale-index status loss or independent-gate self-resealed inconsistency.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D596 Gate and test-profile tests leave consumer asymmetries uncovered.md

findings.title: Verifier description can create or migrate authority state
findings.body: studio_approval calls StudioAuthorityStore constructor, which creates project identity/key directories and keys or migrates legacy key and writes receipt. Bridge calls descriptor during approval setup. No host approval signature is issued here, but operation is not filesystem read-only.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D597 Verifier description can create or migrate authority state.md

findings.title: Preview and dry-run do not mean constructor-free reads
findings.body: Agent preview/workflow dry-run bypass approval but instantiate ordinary controllers, which initialize Studio authority/run control. Their task behavior is nonexecuting. Runs/status instead use open_existing and knowledge browse requests read_only, providing different effect boundaries.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D598 Preview and dry-run do not mean constructor-free reads.md

findings.title: Host approval can be consumed before operation validation fails
findings.body: Dispatcher verifies/consumes proof then parses typed specs, checks task shapes, constructs controllers or resolves later files. Successful proof consumption is not the same as successful requested mutation; later error may require a new approval. Payload mismatch is rejected before consumption by lower verifier, as tested.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D599 Host approval can be consumed before operation validation fails.md

findings.title: Direct draft helpers have a different trust boundary
findings.body: create_draft and admit_skill_source are public Python helpers called directly by tests. They do not perform top-level signed host-proof consumption; they rely on trusted caller and lower source/allocation/controller checks. The CLI routes through studio_operation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D600 Direct draft helpers have a different trust boundary.md

findings.title: Studio transport bounds are not identical across entry routes
findings.body: Base64 decode allocates before decoded 256 KiB check. Stdin reads at most 528 KiB plus sentinel for envelope and does not apply same generic 256 KiB check to read payload. Direct Python studio_operation has no transport bound. Only version-conflict exceptions receive compact structured errors in main.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D601 Studio transport bounds are not identical across entry routes.md

findings.title: Studio protocol validates vocabulary shape but not handler closure
findings.body: Import chooses source registry before packaged fallback; schema/kinds mapping checked. Non-list kinds silently disappear and list members become strings, without nonempty/duplicate/known-operation validation. Parser accepts union while dispatcher pair check and handlers provide later limits.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D602 Studio protocol validates vocabulary shape but not handler closure.md

findings.title: Studio coercion is broader than field names imply
findings.body: _strings accepts arrays but stringifies nonstrings. Workflow required/approval flags use bool and retry counts int, so string false and fractional inputs change meaning before controller checks. Layout validation is stricter: exact nodes, x/y fields, no bool, finite coordinates and absolute bound.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D603 Studio coercion is broader than field names imply.md

findings.title: Authority sidecar stores input contract but deliberately omits runtime values
findings.body: Workflow envelope validates run_inputs mapping but stores contract descriptors and runtime_input_values_stored=False, not actual run inputs. Default contracts derive undriven input ports; supplied nonempty list replaces inference. Execution inputs arrive at run/start/resume separately.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D604 Authority sidecar stores input contract but deliberately omits runtime values.md

findings.title: Agent start branches by harness owner
findings.body: start uses prepare_host_run for harness:vscode-lm; other harnesses call start_harness. run uses invoke_harness, and complete-host-run is separate authenticated completion route. Treating all agent starts as identical subprocess execution hides the host-model handoff.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D605 Agent start branches by harness owner.md

findings.title: Agency compilation authenticates metadata shape rather than source truth
findings.body: Selection valid is truthy, route receipt only nonempty, score evidence only matching agent row. Plan/body/manifest digests have length checks but no hex/content/signature verification. Authority/budget ceilings are supplied by caller, and int coercion permits booleans/truncated numeric values.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D606 Agency compilation authenticates metadata shape rather than source truth.md

findings.title: Agency request submission does not revalidate request hash
findings.body: Frozen dataclass includes mutable budgets mapping; submit accepts request attributes and callable create without recomputing hash or checking executor/type. Altered checkpoint values can be forwarded with unchanged hash. This is a record submission boundary, not proof of execution authorization.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D607 Agency request submission does not revalidate request hash.md

findings.title: Agency capability and route evidence do not survive create arguments
findings.body: Request includes allowed_capabilities and agency_route_receipt_sha256, but submit forwards neither. It forwards specialist revision, request hash, plan/authority/budgets only. Downstream execution must establish capability authority independently. Source compiler callers found in tests; runtime wrapper does not compile or launch.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D608 Agency capability and route evidence do not survive create arguments.md

findings.title: Studio test approval is simulated fixture authority
findings.body: Testkit installs a committed test-only public verifier and signs claims with fixture key material while labelling host/human context. Tests establish validation behavior under fixture authority, not real user approval. Helper can overwrite selected verifier and depends on caller test isolation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D609 Studio test approval is simulated fixture authority.md

findings.title: Studio test coverage distinguishes artifact identity from all operations
findings.body: API tests cover immutable revisions, allocation conflicts, layout, source attestation, signature/replay and selected agent/workflow fixture runs. Catalogue drift test preserves admission authentication while promotion status fails. No complete operation-by-operation execution receipt is established by these tests or this source review.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D610 Studio test coverage distinguishes artifact identity from all operations.md

findings.title: Skill comparison limits apply after full tree hashing
findings.body: _comparison_tree calls inventory_tree before checking 512 files/16 MiB. Inventory sorts full rglob and hashes all files; hydration and description read whole text. Returned candidate/change limits do not bound total read work.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D611 Skill comparison limits apply after full tree hashing.md

findings.title: Native backup verifier permits empty source denominator
findings.body: verify_backup never requires BACKUP_SCHEMA or nonempty sources; an empty sources manifest returns valid. Source/inventory/record paths are joined without resolved snapshot containment, and malformed structures may raise instead of returning invalid.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D612 Native backup verifier permits empty source denominator.md

findings.title: Native restore rejects an advertised empty destination
findings.body: restore_backup permits absent or empty destination in its precheck, then copy_verified rejects any existing target. Existing empty directory therefore fails. Restore also mutates copied files for CRLF reconstruction before final tree check, leaving partial output on failure.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D613 Native restore rejects an advertised empty destination.md

findings.title: Native body identity and returned text are separate observations
findings.body: Hash helper accepts raw bytes or newline-normalized text, and hydration opens body again afterward. Concurrent change can make returned content differ from checked hash. Preserved query records derive a new current body hash rather than authenticating original custody manifest.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D614 Native body identity and returned text are separate observations.md

findings.title: Native query grants and admission remain metadata assertions
findings.body: Domain access checks grant strings, selectability trusts active/admitted labels or allow-unadmitted grant. Exact lookup returns first visible ID, so requesting multiple domains can select canonical before derived preserved record. Semantic query is weighted token overlap, not model-based semantic evaluation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D615 Native query grants and admission remain metadata assertions.md

findings.title: Native package validation checks selected packaging invariants
findings.body: Manifest JSON equality/id/domain, required path existence, resource list and body hash are checked. Package root itself is not uniformly constrained to PX root; schema/version/whole support-file hashes/admission evidence and actual tests are not established. Empty native record set can pass.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D616 Native package validation checks selected packaging invariants.md

findings.title: First migration can fail before its first recoverable journal
findings.body: Snapshots and workspace/user backup copies occur before main journal creation. Failure leaves snapshot custody that causes a later no-journal run to refuse legacy state. Partial prepared-skills directory skips rebuild and can later be published before missing package detection.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D617 First migration can fail before its first recoverable journal.md

findings.title: Migration resume does not bind all original preparation inputs
findings.body: Main journal binds workspace tree but catalog/enterprise metadata and prepared package contents are not one frozen transaction identity. Catalog is reread on resume; existing native package validation checks only selected identity fields. Initial source IDs are used as path components without local sanitization.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D618 Migration resume does not bind all original preparation inputs.md

findings.title: Publication recovery trusts more path data than preparation checks
findings.body: Prepare resolves target under root, but recovery checks lexical target path and reads after_image from manifest without resolved transaction containment or link-ancestor checks. Journal schema/denominator are not fully validated, committed state is skipped, and per-file replace has no shared lock/fsync or before-image rollback.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D619 Publication recovery trusts more path data than preparation checks.md

findings.title: Eligibility refresh updates declaration consistency not admission proof
findings.body: Eligibility derives active/admitted index labels, changes package isolation flags, rebuilds index and packaging and commits after-images. It does not authenticate lifecycle receipts or execute package validation. Recovery of prior transactions runs before new update construction.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D620 Eligibility refresh updates declaration consistency not admission proof.md

findings.title: Migration maintenance modes can rewrite broad source outside lifecycle owner
findings.body: rewrite_operational_paths replaces every matching string across runtime/tests/scripts and selected registries without transaction or semantic parsing, then rewrites packaging. CLI flags are precedence-selected rather than mutually exclusive. Backup sealing writes inventories/manifest before final verification.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D621 Migration maintenance modes can rewrite broad source outside lifecycle owner.md

findings.title: Packaging render discards content following generated start
findings.body: render takes prefix before first START and appends a freshly generated section, never retaining suffix after END. Unrelated TOML sections after block can be lost while parsed output remains valid. Duplicate tests cover repeated generated keys but not retained suffix.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D622 Packaging render discards content following generated start.md

findings.title: Packaging path emission relies on trusted filenames and overlays
findings.body: File values and destinations are quoted by interpolation without TOML escaping. Logical overlay names are unvalidated; external staged paths can fail root-relative sorting. Canonical native root symlinks rejected, but facade directories lack same root check. No bounded enumeration or hash attestation is performed by renderer.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D623 Packaging path emission relies on trusted filenames and overlays.md

findings.title: Lifecycle reconciliation writes before final denominator checks
findings.body: Specialty state map collapses duplicate IDs and accepts arbitrary state strings. Script writes specialty/packages/ledgers before discovering some missing records, and writes catalog before checking every specialty matched. It does not update through signed SkillStudio lifecycle transaction.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D624 Lifecycle reconciliation writes before final denominator checks.md

findings.title: Commissioned skill reconciliation can miss non-row drift
findings.body: Changed detection uses first matching current row and stale ID set; duplicate identical rows or top-level metadata drift can leave check valid. Apply directly rewrites complete expected file only when row delta exists and returns true without reread.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D625 Commissioned skill reconciliation can miss non-row drift.md

findings.title: Skill packaging tests partly reuse implementation corpus
findings.body: Expected file coverage calls generator._owned_files, sharing its exclusions. The test loop named facades iterates .px/skills, not .agents/skills. Manifest projection counts are checked, but no artifact build/install occurs in this test file.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D626 Skill packaging tests partly reuse implementation corpus.md

findings.title: Native and migration tests cover selected successful recovery boundaries
findings.body: Tests prove fixture backup bytes/CRLF/order, query caps and domain denial; migration resumes after journaled relocation and detects first-snapshot drift. Pre-journal, partial-prepare, empty-denominator/destination, path trust and post-END data-loss cases remain untested here.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D627 Native and migration tests cover selected successful recovery boundaries.md

findings.title: Skill library vocabulary tests are documentation coverage
findings.body: Library tests require provenance/clean-room/freshness labels, hashes and specific words in references. These are packaging/documentation invariants, not demonstrations of the named runtime mechanism or independent provenance verification.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D628 Skill library vocabulary tests are documentation coverage.md

findings.title: Native helper tests do not prove all capability execution
findings.body: Support tests exercise ledger/report fixtures, owner/test path checks and a selected declared-suite outcome count. The separately reviewed helper implementations define actual scope; current execution and all-procedure behavior are not claimed.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D629 Native helper tests do not prove all capability execution.md

findings.title: Isolation pre-move resume skips a fresh snapshot check
findings.body: Comparison occurs in snapshots-and-backup-verified. Resuming pre-move-verified can move changed source before destination hash detects mismatch.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D630 Isolation pre-move resume skips a fresh snapshot check.md

findings.title: Isolation move and phase record are separate effects
findings.body: Move precedes source-relocated journal write. Interruption leaves destination present with earlier state and blocks ordinary retry. Initial backup copies also precede main journal.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D631 Isolation move and phase record are separate effects.md

findings.title: Manifest mutation precedes journaled custody pointer
findings.body: Helper saves bytes and clears installer metadata before caller stores returned receipt. Restart may return already-empty without original restoration pointer.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D632 Manifest mutation precedes journaled custody pointer.md

findings.title: Unknown pending isolation state can return valid
findings.body: Selected pending states handled explicitly, then function returns reconciled valid without requiring committed terminal state. Blocked/unknown state can fall through.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D633 Unknown pending isolation state can return valid.md

findings.title: Isolation invocation paths are not fully bound on resume
findings.body: Existing journal not compared with new live/relocation arguments. Disjoint check covers live versus relocation only; backup manifest paths trusted beyond byte hashes.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D634 Isolation invocation paths are not fully bound on resume.md

findings.title: Empty committed live tree may hide installer reappearance
findings.body: Already-committed empty source can return without clearing newly populated installer metadata. Tree emptiness and discoverability are separate state.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D635 Empty committed live tree may hide installer reappearance.md

findings.title: Restore has no prepared transaction or isolation lock
findings.body: Restore moves original before manifest and final journal update. Failure after move leaves committed journal pointing at absent destination. Pending reconciliation not checked.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D636 Restore has no prepared transaction or isolation lock.md

findings.title: Restored manifest and tree can belong to different generations
findings.body: First original tree is restored with most recent isolated manifest. Empty current skills check permits overwriting other new metadata. Historical trees remain separate.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D637 Restored manifest and tree can belong to different generations.md

findings.title: Isolation test proves recorded recovery seam only
findings.body: Fixture stops after journaled relocation. Effect-before-journal windows, unknown pending states, changed paths, concurrent and multiple-generation restore remain untested here.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D638 Isolation test proves recorded recovery seam only.md

findings.title: Campaign validation is structural and self-hashed
findings.body: Exact stages/prefix and identity self-hash checked, without full provenance field typing/authentication. isinstance(int) accepts bool apply_count. Pre-identity failure marker is caller assertion.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D639 Campaign validation is structural and self-hashed.md

findings.title: Fresh campaign status has limited state and input scope
findings.body: Source verification defaults false and only runs for active/certified, not failed. Selected product/harness digests and repair ID do not cover phase/intake or all provenance.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D640 Fresh campaign status has limited state and input scope.md

findings.title: Campaign claim concurrency depends on external owner
findings.body: Read-check-write has no local lock/CAS. Claims lack process/expiry. CLI has orchestration boundary; direct concurrent helpers can overwrite claims.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D641 Campaign claim concurrency depends on external owner.md

findings.title: Finish does not repeat all claim conditions
findings.body: Matching claim and source check do not require unchanged phase, closed intake or zero unresolved work. Intervening repair state change can escape finish checks.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D642 Finish does not repeat all claim conditions.md

findings.title: Certified campaign label consumes caller outcome
findings.body: Helper uses passed truthiness without receipt reference, gate denominator or signature validation. CLI explicit finish or output.valid supplies boolean; terminal label records owner outcome.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D643 Certified campaign label consumes caller outcome.md

findings.title: Release archive filename trusts campaign ID
findings.body: Nonempty ID validation permits separators while archive paths interpolate ID without resolved containment. Parent creation/write is not a containment boundary.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D644 Release archive filename trusts campaign ID.md

findings.title: Archive and successor pointer split on interruption
findings.body: Exclusive archive write/fsync precedes successor pointer replacement. Interruption leaves old pointer and archive collision on retry, without a multi-file recovery journal.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D645 Archive and successor pointer split on interruption.md

findings.title: Release recovery paths preserve different history
findings.body: Clear for different repair/campaign can replace state without supersession archive. Successor attempts increment under eligibility rules without universal one-attempt ceiling; repair phase rewinds separately.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D646 Release recovery paths preserve different history.md

findings.title: Release package and install branches are audits of existing artifacts
findings.body: package_audit records artifact_rebuilt False; install_audit records install_command_executed False. Stage pass advances campaign based on observed retained bytes, not building/installing current source.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D647 Release package and install branches are audits of existing artifacts.md

findings.title: Artifact and source identity are co-recorded without build derivation
findings.body: VSIX audit binds configured bytes/count/CRC and attaches current kernel digests. It does not reproduce build or compare artifact content with all current source. Existing annotated Git tag is moved locally, not remotely published here.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D648 Artifact and source identity are co-recorded without build derivation.md

findings.title: Owner input containment does not cover interpolated IDs and external roots
findings.body: inside checks nominal/resolved project path ancestors, but candidate/predecessor strings lack safe-component validation and later form receipt/log filenames. Installed directory/code command resolve outside root without the same reparse checks; numeric values coerce via int.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D649 Owner input containment does not cover interpolated IDs and external roots.md

findings.title: Owner running marker creates a durable no-retry boundary before effects
findings.body: Marker is written before dispatch; general failures do not always replace it with failed receipt. Fresh-output checks reject rerun. Stage finish, phase advance and final receipt order differ by branch and can split on interruption.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D650 Owner running marker creates a durable no-retry boundary before effects.md

findings.title: Git identity transition has multiple independently persisted intermediate states
findings.body: Index add precedes exact cached-set validation, commit precedes post-dirty check, and retag precedes identity apply/receipt. Failures can leave staged changes, new commit or moved tag without completed owner receipt.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D651 Git identity transition has multiple independently persisted intermediate states.md

findings.title: Installed audit requires one changed but equivalent package JSON
findings.body: Byte-identical package.json increments identical rather than normalized; valid requires normalized == 1. A fully byte-identical install can fail. Only observed __metadata is removed for normalized equality.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D652 Installed audit requires one changed but equivalent package JSON.md

findings.title: Archive and tree audits are not fully bounded snapshots
findings.body: CRC and archive.read process full uncompressed data without expansion budget; installed files read whole. install entries collapse duplicate names; install audit lacks final artifact hash recapture. Tree walk omits onerror and uses path checks then later reads.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D653 Archive and tree audits are not fully bounded snapshots.md

findings.title: Stage process closure is strongest on handled timeout only
findings.body: command attempts taskkill/process-group termination on TimeoutExpired; ordinary exit does not independently prove descendants exited, and other exceptions/cancellation lack matching finally closure. Nested processes and temporary VS Code profile are not registered here.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D654 Stage process closure is strongest on handled timeout only.md

findings.title: Owner receipt verification is selective rather than semantic replay
findings.body: Verifier checks state, schema, candidate, selected claim/identity/artifact fields and registered resource status. It does not rerun full audit or validate all receipt counts/log hashes. Hardcoded resource zero fields do not enumerate unregistered effects.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D655 Owner receipt verification is selective rather than semantic replay.md

findings.title: Default stage-owner plan returns unsuccessful CLI exit status
findings.body: plan returns effects False but no valid field; main returns zero only when output.get(valid) is truthy. Default plan therefore prints plan and exits 1. Tests call plan directly, not default CLI exit.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D656 Default stage-owner plan returns unsuccessful CLI exit status.md

findings.title: Owner tests often replace actual operational effects
findings.body: FakeEffects verifier is no-op across stage-selection tests. Git, source classifier, supersession, process and extension listing are mocked for selected seams. No real full package/install or interrupted multi-file campaign is proven by these cases.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D657 Owner tests often replace actual operational effects.md

findings.title: Effect inventory resolves spellings rather than all effects
findings.body: Literal dotted process/network names and mutation leaves omit import aliases, dynamic dispatch, open-write modes, other languages and native effects. Some method-name matches may be unrelated operations. IDs encode locator, not argument semantics.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D658 Effect inventory resolves spellings rather than all effects.md

findings.title: Popen timeout association ignores control flow and nearest scope
findings.body: AST walk chooses first containing function, potentially outer; any matching handle wait/communicate with timeout keyword can satisfy association even unreachable or unrelated after reassignment. timeout None is nonempty syntax, not bounded execution.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D659 Popen timeout association ignores control flow and nearest scope.md

findings.title: Effect validator accepts expressions it does not evaluate
findings.body: Rejects shell only when unparsed expression equals True; variables/truthy alternatives can pass. Timeout only requires non-None metadata, not positive finite value. Network timeout and actual process closure are not checked.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D660 Effect validator accepts expressions it does not evaluate.md

findings.title: Policy ownership fields are declarations without enforcement evidence
findings.body: Discovery stamps approval and containment text. Validation checks policy file existence and filename-based destructive exceptions, not receipts, actual retained backup, admission or resolved effect target. Special process owners receive timeout labels without local control-flow proof.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D661 Policy ownership fields are declarations without enforcement evidence.md

findings.title: Effect tests share discovery denominator with generated expected registry
findings.body: Fixture expected records are produced by discovery itself. Tests cover selected literal unsafe calls/pruning; no alias, expression, nested scope or enforcement receipt cases. Locator hash test hashes a constant without invoking discovery.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D662 Effect tests share discovery denominator with generated expected registry.md

findings.title: Driver journal does not bind resumed configuration
findings.body: Journal checks schema/candidate only, not full config/owner argv/timeouts/artifact/control roots. Resumed readiness drops initial hygiene/predecessor checks; supplied current config can change remaining execution under same candidate.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D663 Driver journal does not bind resumed configuration.md

findings.title: Driver owner command authority is largely configuration supplied
findings.body: Every stage requires one nonempty argv, but only four card-reconcile commands have exact tails. Python check is filename substring. Other owners are not matched to canonical module, executable hash or declared effect inventory.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D664 Driver owner command authority is largely configuration supplied.md

findings.title: Admission IDs are recorded without local scope guard before execution
findings.body: execute-next requires nonempty IDs in main, then records them; execute-all appends admissions. Neither driver nor stage owner invokes guard-work before scoped effects. Run/lane IDs propagated to child are not admission/checkpoint IDs.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D665 Admission IDs are recorded without local scope guard before execution.md

findings.title: Candidate work sessions describe read write execute only
findings.body: Per-stage admission generates those three effects and authority text from candidate config. Network/install/service/destructive effects in arbitrary configured commands receive no separate admission from this helper. Caller/owner enforcement remains necessary.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D666 Candidate work sessions describe read write execute only.md

findings.title: Candidate journal is replace-written without concurrency control
findings.body: Journal start/finish overwrite full JSON without lock/CAS/hash chain. Next-step ignores unknown extra keys and does not validate all attempt/evidence fields. Running/failed state intentionally blocks replay but does not reconcile effects interrupted before terminal publication.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D667 Candidate journal is replace-written without concurrency control.md

findings.title: Resumed aggregate report does not count earlier successful invocations
findings.body: execute_all starts empty stages and final valid requires len(stages)==12, despite running only remaining steps. Successful partial resume or already-complete campaign returns invalid aggregate. Admission failure branch reports completed_stage_count zero even after prior loop successes.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D668 Resumed aggregate report does not count earlier successful invocations.md

findings.title: Candidate settlement and report are not protected by final cleanup
findings.body: next_pending_step and governance.settle can raise outside per-owner catch. BaseException cancellation bypasses ordinary Exception handlers; session/process or terminal journal/report may remain unsettled. Closure precedes checkpoint, so checkpoint failure can leave a closed session without report progress.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D669 Candidate settlement and report are not protected by final cleanup.md

findings.title: Candidate checkpoint drops older unresolved branch carry-forward
findings.body: settle computes unresolved branches only from newly discovered cards since previous checkpoint; prior unresolved list is not merged. Its append-only journal claim describes a file replaced at each update, not immutable event storage.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D670 Candidate checkpoint drops older unresolved branch carry-forward.md

findings.title: Candidate resource completion checks counters but not valid flag
findings.body: After complete_process, four counters must equal zero; resource_status.valid is not required. Lifecycle proof field is set true after selected checks. Non-timeout exceptions/cancellation lack unconditional terminate/reconcile; late command can spawn before remaining deadline becomes zero.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D671 Candidate resource completion checks counters but not valid flag.md

findings.title: Installed smoke and lifecycle evidence bodies are not interpreted
findings.body: Exact member set and selected success fields are checked; referenced smoke/lifecycle files are hash-checked only. Fixture accepts arbitrary ok/closed JSON. No semantic smoke schema, embedded artifact identity or lifecycle closure replay is required here.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D672 Installed smoke and lifecycle evidence bodies are not interpreted.md

findings.title: Installed summary cross-binding is selective and unsigned
findings.body: Package/install receipt fields and exhaustive report/count agreement are stronger than labels alone, but live kernel self-hash/source freshness, receipt signatures and finished-time recency are not checked. Exhaustive receipt path need not equal configured installed_exhaustive_receipt.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D673 Installed summary cross-binding is selective and unsigned.md

findings.title: Derived exhaustive error counts use recursive normalized key search
findings.body: Any matching key at any depth contributes length or int-coerced value; conflicts fail but schema/location/type meaning not established. Booleans/numeric strings can be accepted. Full recursive JSON traversal has no local depth/size limit.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D674 Derived exhaustive error counts use recursive normalized key search.md

findings.title: Postcondition replay observes selected state rather than every original receipt
findings.body: Phase-at-least permits later states for earlier owners. Archive cleared branch allows empty all-pending denominator; some stage checks omit campaign/identity validation. Preflight accepts claimed certify without independently checking preflight report; finalize observes certified state rather than signature validation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D675 Postcondition replay observes selected state rather than every original receipt.md

findings.title: Driver test success isolates many real proof producers
findings.body: Fake owners/governance and automatic hygiene patch prove orchestration shape. Synthetic installed proof uses minimal smoke/lifecycle JSON. Tests do not establish actual multi-host execution, resumed aggregate correctness or guard-work enforcement.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D676 Driver test success isolates many real proof producers.md

findings.title: Corrective closed status requires only receipt existence
findings.body: Contained receipt path must be a file, but content, validity, signature, source freshness and relation to card/command are not inspected. Same minimal receipt can close every card, as test explicitly demonstrates.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D677 Corrective closed status requires only receipt existence.md

findings.title: Corrective dependency and child validation has no order or cycle proof
findings.body: Known IDs required, but self/cyclic dependency/parent relationships and unresolved prerequisites are not rejected. Fixed source IDs establish historical denominator; arbitrary additional child IDs need only known parent.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D678 Corrective dependency and child validation has no order or cycle proof.md

findings.title: Corrective acceptance syntax checks do not prove runnable target behavior
findings.body: Pytest form may have no target and checks only tokens beginning tests; selector existence/other paths/options not validated. Python script form checks file existence without resolved root containment. CLI allowlist is fixed including historical version strings.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D679 Corrective acceptance syntax checks do not prove runnable target behavior.md

findings.title: Corrective malformed records can escape structured error output
findings.body: Top-level nonobject reaches .get; nonobject card is recorded as error but final blocking_open still calls .get on every card. Unhashable dependency/status/priority shapes can also raise. Strict finalizer exception may return valid while blocking_open remains nonzero.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D680 Corrective malformed records can escape structured error output.md

findings.title: Hygiene targets are named custody rather than authenticated ownership
findings.body: Static paths, most .tmp directories and broad TEMP prefixes become disposable labels without resource owner/retention/terminal proof. Descriptions claiming empty or abandoned are not independently checked.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D681 Hygiene targets are named custody rather than authenticated ownership.md

findings.title: Quarantine path trust changes across selection and resume
findings.body: Selection resolves root links before inventory and can redirect nominal transient path. Resume trusts recorded source/destination paths without containment/run-root checks; manifest path can be external. Initial destination containment does not validate every resumed record.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D682 Quarantine path trust changes across selection and resume.md

findings.title: Quarantine uses one snapshot and cross-volume-capable move
findings.body: One tree snapshot is retained before journal and shutil.move, without two matching snapshots or immediate pre-move equality. shutil.move can copy/delete across volumes. No local lock or complete source/destination transaction recovery.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D683 Quarantine uses one snapshot and cross-volume-capable move.md

findings.title: Resume can replace mismatched before-evidence with current destination
findings.body: When source absent/destination exists and evidence differs, resume overwrites evidence with post-move tree and labels prior traversal denied/ACL remediation. It does not establish denial or actual remediation occurred before accepting match.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D684 Resume can replace mismatched before-evidence with current destination.md

findings.title: Quarantine completion does not require every record to reach moved
findings.body: Existing moved records skipped; unresolved record with both paths absent can escape pending target loop, followed by valid True. Later validator does not require cleanup_result moved and empty records are accepted if selected counters zero.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D685 Quarantine completion does not require every record to reach moved.md

findings.title: Quarantine validation manufactures a user-authorization field
findings.body: hard_delete_authorized_by_user is unconditionally True although helper accepts no approval input. all_items_no_longer_needed derives hash/absence/class labels, not retention authority. This report does not treat those fields as permission.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D686 Quarantine validation manufactures a user-authorization field.md

findings.title: Quarantine validator checks narrow resource and manifest conditions
findings.body: No workspace/run/source/destination containment or nonempty manifest denominator is required. resource_status.valid and reclaimable_paths are not checked; three counters alone gate cleanliness. Missing destination can hash as empty tree.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D687 Quarantine validator checks narrow resource and manifest conditions.md

findings.title: Hygiene filesystem survey does not bound all work or reparse types
findings.body: Snapshot/assessment use unbounded os.walk without onerror and detect symlinks rather than all Windows reparse/junctions. Preserved-link test uses resolved target containment; root resolution hides initial link identity. File stat/hash observations are separate.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D688 Hygiene filesystem survey does not bound all work or reparse types.md

findings.title: Intentionally stale receipt exception trusts shape and lineage labels
findings.body: Predicate requires nonempty ID, boolean passed/fresh and current False, including failed receipts, without authenticating intact receipt bytes. Group aggregate valid is not itself a readiness requirement when no blocking stale rows remain.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D689 Intentionally stale receipt exception trusts shape and lineage labels.md

findings.title: Hygiene readiness contains asserted isolation results
findings.body: cross_workspace_contamination is fixed zero, workspace isolation valid True and unknown unresolved list empty. Validator reruns fresh assess and compares artifact object, but does not verify a signed certificate, old report source identity or all external custody. Git tag query is fixed v0.7.0.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D690 Hygiene readiness contains asserted isolation results.md

findings.title: Composed audit inherits component semantics and sequential observations
findings.body: Integration validation runs smoke mode; others perform syntax/hash/topology/presence checks. Aggregate bool-coerces passed values, has no per-component exception capture and no single frozen source snapshot. It is not an all-behavior execution proof.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D691 Composed audit inherits component semantics and sequential observations.md

findings.title: Generated artifact scope has lexical exceptions
findings.body: Root pytest cache excluded, unlike pre-candidate target selection. Generated rows beginning extension/dist are filtered by string prefix, potentially covering similarly named directories. Walk limit and skip policy do not prove excluded content safe.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D692 Generated artifact scope has lexical exceptions.md

findings.title: Python ownership audit validates map paths and bytes only
findings.body: Map rows collapse into path dictionary, hiding duplicates. Check compares actual SHA and missing/unmapped paths, not schema/counts/role/evidence-level truth. Passed source hash inventory does not prove operational ownership.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D693 Python ownership audit validates map paths and bytes only.md

findings.title: Several composed topology checks are intentionally weaker than admission
findings.body: Set comparison collapses duplicate skill/workflow IDs; active versus deferred disjointness follows set construction. Policy/model/prompt checks require file presence, and source management requirement inferred from pyproject presence. These checks do not validate behavior of each item.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D694 Several composed topology checks are intentionally weaker than admission.md

findings.title: Python evidence levels can derive from text and supplied success flags
findings.body: Basename/path substring in test text including comments gives evidence-association. Runtime/builder fallback labels full-suite-and-installed-integration without running it. Direct-isolated label uses supplied per-result passed fields without overall certification validity or identity.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D695 Python evidence levels can derive from text and supplied success flags.md

findings.title: Installed Python identity trusts local RECORD and executing module location
findings.body: Package root is current module directory, independent of supplied data root. RECORD provides expected hash but is not authenticated here; unmapped module with RECORD row accepted. Original ownership sha is not compared to installed bytes.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D696 Installed Python identity trusts local RECORD and executing module location.md

findings.title: Python surface enumeration and projection paths have trust limits
findings.body: Source and installed candidates use unbounded rglob/read. Installed ownership paths join without resolved containment; RECORD paths resolve and duplicate rows overwrite. Root overlap can enumerate duplicates. Source mode inferred from markers; role packaging flags are classifications rather than built artifact inventory.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D697 Python surface enumeration and projection paths have trust limits.md

findings.title: Installed syntax records can retain stale syntax-valid labels
findings.body: AST parse errors append global errors but record syntax_valid is copied from source ownership or fallback True. syntax_valid_count subtracts only SyntaxError/UnicodeError strings, not every read failure. Selected map rows/counts are not full semantic certification.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D698 Installed syntax records can retain stale syntax-valid labels.md

findings.title: Hygiene audit and Python tests prove selected boundaries
findings.body: Hygiene tests exercise successful quarantine and original-reappearance denial, not mismatch-replacement resume/retention. Audit tests cover chosen caches and hashes. Python boundary test covers one source-mode interpreter exclusion, with map freshness disabled and no installed branch.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D699 Hygiene audit and Python tests prove selected boundaries.md

findings.title: Agency discovery and validation have different body-read scopes
findings.body: Discovery opens registry metadata only; provider validation reads every body/manifest while returning eager_body_hydration zero. That metric describes context hydration, not bytes read for validation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D700 Agency discovery and validation have different body-read scopes.md

findings.title: Agency routing exact-name shortcut depends on set iteration order
findings.body: normalized_name joins _tokens set without sorting while query is sorted, so cross-process hash seed can change exact-identity substring shortcut. Two same-process calls in tests do not establish cross-process determinism.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D701 Agency routing exact-name shortcut depends on set iteration order.md

findings.title: Agency constraints iterable can be consumed before all routing uses
findings.body: normalize_task receives constraints then discovery and route splat the same iterable again. One-shot generators may lose terms/risk signals across reads; list/tuple callers avoid this path. limit is unvalidated slicing, not a bounded positive candidate contract.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D702 Agency constraints iterable can be consumed before all routing uses.md

findings.title: Zero reviewer maximum can still return a reviewer
findings.body: Selector appends candidate then checks len >= maximum. maximum zero therefore returns first eligible reviewer instead of none. Function distinctness is division/role pair, not demonstrated independent expertise.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D703 Zero reviewer maximum can still return a reviewer.md

findings.title: Agency risk review and selectability remain metadata decisions
findings.body: Risk uses token vocabulary and primary risk label; lifecycle accepts active/advisory. Route does not verify full provider before selecting or establish human review occurred. Declared handoffs generate graph edges rather than actual transfers.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D704 Agency risk review and selectability remain metadata decisions.md

findings.title: Selected hydration budget applies after full reads and footer trimming
findings.body: Body/manifest read and hash precede budget check; material excludes removed operational footer. Huge unreturned suffix can exceed read work bound; full rendered prompt and task/route/policy overhead are not within hydration byte denominator.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D705 Selected hydration budget applies after full reads and footer trimming.md

findings.title: Prompt compiler validates shapes without cross-binding task and route
findings.body: Schema validation raises on shape errors but compiler does not compare task IDs, recompute route/task hashes, require route.valid or unresolved empty, or enforce completed human review. Supplied permitted tools are labelled authority-envelope context but not independently authenticated.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D706 Prompt compiler validates shapes without cross-binding task and route.md

findings.title: Specialist projection currentness omits renderer change when recorded bytes match
findings.body: If disk equals recorded rendered hash and source hash unchanged, classify_projection returns Current without comparing current_rendered_sha256. Renderer/policy-only changes can be invisible in that branch.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D707 Specialist projection currentness omits renderer change when recorded bytes match.md

findings.title: Agency workflow validation checks declared lifecycle set rather than execution order
findings.body: Requires seven step IDs, exact bounds and known dependencies, but does not reject self/cyclic dependencies or require specific ordering and handlers. Wrapper test routes metadata and checks graph, not specialist execution.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D708 Agency workflow validation checks declared lifecycle set rather than execution order.md

findings.title: Agent builder graph is a fixed specification projection
findings.body: Nine required node kinds and three optional kinds with exact derived edges are accepted. Compilation reads configs into AgentSpec; relation names such as authorizes and validates do not themselves grant rights or run tests.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D709 Agent builder graph is a fixed specification projection.md

findings.title: Frozen graph nodes retain mutable nested configuration
findings.body: Node normalizes config to ordinary JSON dict; frozen dataclass prevents attribute assignment but nested dict/list mutation remains possible. Direct compiler/artifact creation does not reconstruct all topology/config validation; persisted verifier does.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D710 Frozen graph nodes retain mutable nested configuration.md

findings.title: Agent compiler defers some config typing to coercion and AgentSpec
findings.body: Closed config keys do not enforce all value types. Binding sequences are iterated and stringified, so malformed strings become character sequences before AgentSpec checks. Model/contracts converted with dict. Per-node 128 KiB limit follows full serialization; raw node/edge arrays have no early cap.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D711 Agent compiler defers some config typing to coercion and AgentSpec.md

findings.title: Optional graph node selection preserves populated specification fields
findings.body: Even if requested node_kinds omits optional kind, nonempty spec binding list still adds it. Explicit optional kinds chiefly retain empty nodes; they do not remove populated tool/memory/handoff bindings.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D712 Optional graph node selection preserves populated specification fields.md

findings.title: Agent layout normalization accepts coercible coordinates and empty falsey input
findings.body: Coordinates converted with float then finite/absolute bound checked. supplied = value or {} accepts empty nonmapping falsey values as default; nonempty unknown mapping keys rejected. Layout edits alter compiler receipt identity without changing AgentSpec.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D713 Agent layout normalization accepts coercible coordinates and empty falsey input.md

findings.title: Agent compiler receipt proves consistency rather than trusted authorship
findings.body: Verifier reconstructs graph, recompiles exact spec and checks expected receipt/hash. All hashes unkeyed and reproducible by a caller; host_authority_retained and authority_granted false are expected declarations, not authenticated runtime grant observations.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D714 Agent compiler receipt proves consistency rather than trusted authorship.md

findings.title: Specialist and builder tests cover preparation rather than runtime panel execution
findings.body: Provider tests verify metadata routing/hydration/notice and wrapper output. Builder tests prove exact graph/spec/layout consistency and selected rejections. No real specialist model invocation, grant resolution, callback execution or reviewer outcome is shown in these test files.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D715 Specialist and builder tests cover preparation rather than runtime panel execution.md

findings.title: Fleet helper dispatch does not instantiate persistent coordinator
findings.body: Clean-room registers readiness, inbox and terminal planning only. Whole-tree Python constructor search found AgentSessionCoordinator call in test fixture, not production Python callers; dynamic external invocation remains possible.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D716 Fleet helper dispatch does not instantiate persistent coordinator.md
