findings.title: Fleet inbox and terminal controls return plans without corresponding effects
findings.body: Inbox serializes before byte cap, checks new candidate but not complete existing-message provenance. Terminal checks metadata and caller authority boolean, returns executed/attached/persisted false. Neither implements authenticated durable inbox or actual terminal action.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D717 Fleet inbox and terminal controls return plans without corresponding effects.md

findings.title: Fleet registration reservations lack completion release
findings.body: Registry keys agent_id across store, validates all same-project participants and sums their costs regardless of lifecycle. No unregister/closed lifecycle API releases reservation; old heartbeat can block new admission.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D718 Fleet registration reservations lack completion release.md

findings.title: Fleet initial registration has a bus-to-projection recovery gap
findings.body: Event publication precedes WAL state/registry. If first projection commit fails, reconstruct requires missing registry/state and cannot rebuild solely from bus. Existing-state rollforward test does not cover initial registration crash.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D719 Fleet initial registration has a bus-to-projection recovery gap.md

findings.title: Fleet session replay is bounded by global traffic rather than session history
findings.body: Requests bus replay limit 10000, then filters project/agent/session. Busy unrelated history can evict anchor from returned suffix although still present physically. Bus itself scans complete ancestry before selecting suffix.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D720 Fleet session replay is bounded by global traffic rather than session history.md

findings.title: Fleet live advance and reconstruction enforce different timestamp rules
findings.body: Canonical replay requires increasing heartbeat timestamp for nonstale advances; _advance does not enforce that monotonicity before persistence. Equal/backward live times can persist while later lagging-state replay rejects equivalent advance. Future age clamps to zero.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D721 Fleet live advance and reconstruction enforce different timestamp rules.md

findings.title: Fleet status can recover state while restart changes only metadata
findings.body: session_status invokes reconstruct_session with lock/WAL recovery and possible projection writes. effective_stale is a view, not automatic stored transition or permission revocation. restart_session changes lifecycle and counters without OS process action.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D722 Fleet status can recover state while restart changes only metadata.md

findings.title: Fleet reconstruction validates the suffix after an existing anchor
findings.body: Current sealed state must match its canonical event, then later transitions are checked. It does not reconstruct missing initial state or replay all earlier lifecycle transitions; mutation lock rechecks local state hash after an earlier unlocked reconstruction phase.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D723 Fleet reconstruction validates the suffix after an existing anchor.md

findings.title: Operational delegation is a returned pathname
findings.body: Fourteen DELEGATED_HANDLERS entries return delegate plus handler and payload hash. No import or call occurs; 43-ID determinism test proves descriptor/result equality rather than 43 executed engines.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D724 Operational delegation is a returned pathname.md

findings.title: Operational decisions consume asserted evidence and require an effect owner
findings.body: Signature/hash booleans, provenance strings, evidence labels and approved templates are evaluated but not authenticated here. Quarantine, promote, stop, admit and complete are returned labels. Memory lexical markers are a selected heuristic, not a general injection proof.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D725 Operational decisions consume asserted evidence and require an effect owner.md

findings.title: Operational policy family edge cases affect plan meaning
findings.body: Bundle conflict check examines candidate conflicts against selected IDs, not both directions. Progress may return complete with missing handoff reasons. Duplicate compiled IDs may make rejected record disappear; read_only accepts truthy strings. NaN gain/cost/risk can evade loop comparisons.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D726 Operational policy family edge cases affect plan meaning.md

findings.title: Engineering topology hash and traversal bounds have specific limits
findings.body: architecture_drift hashes dictionaries containing sets through default=str, which can depend on hash seed. dependency_shockwave checks max_nodes only before inner fanout so results can overshoot; depth clipping can finish with truncated false.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D727 Engineering topology hash and traversal bounds have specific limits.md

findings.title: Engineering health and genome describe supplied data
findings.body: Health certifying means all seven dimension values valid, even seven zeros. Code genome parses source without execution; ImportFrom records alias names without module identity and positional argument count omits other signature structure. Neither proves operating behavior.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D728 Engineering health and genome describe supplied data.md

findings.title: Engineering candidates do not independently validate their evidence
findings.body: DNA selects validated=True labels; opportunities declare measured=True from supplied numbers; patterns count repeated signatures without deduplicating examples or proving generalization. Regression overlaps and weighted score explicitly leave causality false.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D729 Engineering candidates do not independently validate their evidence.md

findings.title: Benchmark evaluable is descriptive completeness rather than regression success
findings.body: Groups candidate/version across fixture versions, summarizes mean/min/max/count, echoes baseline_version without comparison. uncertainty_reported true has no confidence/variance estimate, and nonfinite numeric inputs lack explicit rejection.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D730 Benchmark evaluable is descriptive completeness rather than regression success.md

findings.title: Repository twin merges provenance and lists simulations without running them
findings.body: Static and runtime edges collapse into one set; edge endpoints become nodes so a manifest target only mentioned by edge avoids missing alert. Manifest relations are not added as edges. Simulation interface is a tuple of function names, source_of_truth false.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D731 Repository twin merges provenance and lists simulations without running them.md

findings.title: Engineering tests establish selected pure examples
findings.body: Tests cover small chain, two-run summary, normal AST and candidate flags; do not execute benchmark, delegated engine, real session process, candidate promotion or actual repository health measurement.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D732 Engineering tests establish selected pure examples.md

findings.title: Observer constructors and native decoding are separate integration obligations
findings.body: Repository Python constructor search found OperationalObserverController and ManagedCommandObserverBackend in tests only. Probe is exposed without capture; actual metadata source and event emitter are injected. Empty metadata callback result is not evidence of no OS activity.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D733 Observer constructors and native decoding are separate integration obligations.md

findings.title: Observer command-plan identity does not authenticate mutable command content
findings.body: ObserverCommandPlan validates command keys/nonempty strings and digest format, not digest equality or exact builder argv. Frozen dataclass contains mutable command mapping. start compares declared digest/scope; executable bytes are not bound. Host admission must supply trusted plan and consent.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D734 Observer command-plan identity does not authenticate mutable command content.md

findings.title: Observer native collection scope and returned metadata scope differ
findings.body: ETW command starts kernel-process provider with all keywords, without process/project filters derived from scope_refs. Linux builder watches exact supplied directory but does not recompute its path-sha256 scope label. Returned observation subset check constrains emitted metadata, not necessarily native collection.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D735 Observer native collection scope and returned metadata scope differ.md

findings.title: Observer consent and metadata validators check shape rather than provenance
findings.body: granted uses truthiness and numeric limits are comparisons without strict integer typing. Scope prefixes permit arbitrary suffix text; observation operation/ID are bounded free strings and timestamp has no consent-window chronology check. metadata_only label does not itself verify content provenance.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D736 Observer consent and metadata validators check shape rather than provenance.md

findings.title: Observer time and volume caps do not autonomously terminate collection
findings.body: Expiry checked only at start of capture; health and idle time do not stop backend. Count/byte exhaustion drops returned records but leaves native backend active. Decoder call may block/allocate before bounded iteration, and iterator exceptions occur outside backend.read failure wrapper.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D737 Observer time and volume caps do not autonomously terminate collection.md

findings.title: Observer retained state and native process state have separate recovery lifecycles
findings.body: Reads verify active status and consent hash but not state schema/receipt/digest; state counters/times are mutable. New managed backend active flag false does not reconstruct native session, so stop may no-op while retained active state is later marked disabled. No native session discovery/rebind exists here.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D738 Observer retained state and native process state have separate recovery lifecycles.md

findings.title: Observer failed shutdown blocks the same API retry path
findings.body: disable requires state active and stores blocked on native failure; subsequent disable rejects blocked. enable rejects any retained state, including disabled/uninstalled. Successful stop precedes commit, whose failure leaves persistence behind native state.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D739 Observer failed shutdown blocks the same API retry path.md

findings.title: Observer outbox persists events before optional best-effort delivery
findings.body: WAL groups current state/receipt/event, then emitter receives event. Delivery result returned but not committed to acknowledgement ledger and no retry/drain implemented. Observations are returned separately; event holds aggregated effect labels and state digest.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D740 Observer outbox persists events before optional best-effort delivery.md

findings.title: Observer cumulative losses and current health can diverge
findings.body: Capture health uses current batch drops/backend degraded label, not cumulative dropped_events; later clean batch can become healthy while historical loss remains. Expiry stop failure records blocked but action expire does not end _failed, so operation-event result still success.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D741 Observer cumulative losses and current health can diverge.md

findings.title: Observer tests prove fake lifecycle rather than native telemetry
findings.body: FakeRunner records argv against fake executable bytes; FakeBackend supplies metadata/liveness. Tests cover commit rollback and selected sanitized failures, not native decoder completeness, autonomous expiry, host restart closure or redelivery.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D742 Observer tests prove fake lifecycle rather than native telemetry.md

findings.title: Canonical health authority is metadata and chronology is relative
findings.body: Claim fields and supplied authority are checked against registry, but producer identity/signature and observed truth not verified. TTL compares observation to supplied evaluated_at. Validator reuses report evaluated_at, allowing historical consistent reports without proving freshness now.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D743 Canonical health authority is metadata and chronology is relative.md

findings.title: Python and extension lifecycle rules differ on detected-only state
findings.body: Python explicitly permits detected true with configured false and its test requires that behavior. extension/src/healthState.js throws detected-requires-configured for the same booleans. No direct consumer of px.extension-health-input schema was found in extension JS search.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D744 Python and extension lifecycle rules differ on detected-only state.md

findings.title: Health partial derivation and full projection have different coverage contracts
findings.body: assess_health_report require_complete=False supports Doctor one-claim use. validate_health_report always demands all canonical surfaces, so partial reports cannot pass extension export. Registry is reopened per claim and validation, not frozen as one read snapshot.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D745 Health partial derivation and full projection have different coverage contracts.md

findings.title: Health success ordering and overall precedence are deliberate projections
findings.body: Blockers dominate staleness; staleness dominates degradation. Failure strictly newer than success is unresolved, so equal timestamps allow success to prevail. Overall selects blocked/stale/degraded/unknown/healthy across records; valid means report well formed, not all healthy.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D746 Health success ordering and overall precedence are deliberate projections.md

findings.title: Health tests validate supplied facts and reject internal inconsistency
findings.body: Seven synthetic claims at fixed time exercise chronology, forged states/summary/age/authority and deep-copy projection. No authenticated live observation or JS consumer integration is demonstrated by these tests.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D747 Health tests validate supplied facts and reject internal inconsistency.md

findings.title: Candidate trace checks adjacency without full membership authority
findings.body: Exact stage sequence and preserving-phase equality enforced, but filters need not output subset of input and item.required false overrides required component set membership. Optional failure must abstain; presence of required component alone does not force success under override.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D748 Candidate trace checks adjacency without full membership authority.md

findings.title: Candidate result hashes do not bind all original evidence
findings.body: Trace hash covers valid/stages/removals/errors, not exact candidate identities/components/raw trace. Independent-score evidence hash covers changed IDs rather than numeric scores. Different raw inputs can produce same valid summary/hash.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D749 Candidate result hashes do not bind all original evidence.md

findings.title: Candidate package closure has distinct selection and dependency phases
findings.body: Records collapse duplicate IDs. Greedy selection may consume budget before dependencies and then report incomplete instead of backtracking. Added dependencies increase cost/kinds but do not update covered capabilities/family counts; negative/nonfinite costs lack explicit rejection.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D750 Candidate package closure has distinct selection and dependency phases.md

findings.title: Atomic budget and checkout names describe pure decisions
findings.body: reserve_budget returns proposed active reservation without store/lock; checkout compares supplied version/state and returns lease without CAS publication or project/work binding of current record. Concurrent callers supplied same input can both receive active decisions.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D751 Atomic budget and checkout names describe pure decisions.md

findings.title: Completion numeric and identity checks require caller constraints
findings.body: Nonfinite budget/quota/cost can bypass comparisons. Runtime selection uses healthy/trust/scope labels and treats empty scope as unrestricted. Job succeeded requires nonempty stringified evidence IDs, not valid receipts; terminal idempotent call can replace prior evidence.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D752 Completion numeric and identity checks require caller constraints.md

findings.title: Temporal evidence queries and invalidation remain supplied-data operations
findings.body: Queries use valid/known half-open intervals and current revoked flag, return original mappings, and do not resolve contradictory facts. Invalidation has no explicit size cap; one-shot dependency iterables may be consumed before later fixed-point propagation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D753 Temporal evidence queries and invalidation remain supplied-data operations.md

findings.title: Offline evaluation and delivery validate asserted measurements
findings.body: Distinct actor/optimizer/judge strings do not prove independent actors. Scores and independent-check names supplied; duplicate case IDs collapse and nonfinite scores not rejected. Repository fingerprint hashes provided path/size/digest metadata without filesystem reads.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D754 Offline evaluation and delivery validate asserted measurements.md

findings.title: Completion workflow validator checks names rather than executable ownership
findings.body: Workflow ID set hides duplicates; only verify step presence and known dependency IDs required. Duplicate steps/cycles/arbitrary or missing handlers can pass these checks. Tests assert declaration result, not actual workflow execution.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D755 Completion workflow validator checks names rather than executable ownership.md

findings.title: Extension activation rollback covers registered synchronous disposables
findings.body: Registers before fault callback and reverses pending order. Disposal exceptions swallowed and promises not awaited. Same object already in subscriptions can be removed on rollback; pre-registration effects require their own owner.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D756 Extension activation rollback covers registered synchronous disposables.md

findings.title: Canonical workspace selection is path policy rather than admission
findings.body: Project/folder config wins, explicit empty detaches, global ignored, fallback uses marker existence in first open folder. Explicit path not checked here; relative resolution uses process cwd, not project root.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D757 Canonical workspace selection is path policy rather than admission.md

findings.title: JavaScript SDK is a partial envelope boundary
findings.body: Clones unbounded JSON and checks selected object/identity/enums; does not validate exact full event schema, route registry, effect vocabulary, hash fields or time. Activity/MCP builders call it before stronger Python ingress checks.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D758 JavaScript SDK is a partial envelope boundary.md

findings.title: SDK wrapper reuses event identity and couples action result to emit failures
findings.body: Lifecycle copies keep event_id/time. Start emit failure prevents action; completion emit failure enters action failure handler; failed emit can replace original exception. Production search found builder calls but no instrumentOperation use.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D759 SDK wrapper reuses event identity and couples action result to emit failures.md

findings.title: Extension event queue admits references and routes at flush time
findings.body: publish byte-checks serialization then stores original mutable object. Later mutation can exceed bound or break serialization. update changes workspace/engine roots without partitioning or draining queue, so pending earlier events use current flush destination.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D760 Extension event queue admits references and routes at flush time.md

findings.title: Publisher failure and acknowledgement have bounded but incomplete semantics
findings.body: Batch spliced before send and no retry. Child exit zero with truthy result.valid is accepted without exact event receipt/count identity; published zero falls back to batch length in health. In-memory queue lacks durable outbox.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D761 Publisher failure and acknowledgement have bounded but incomplete semantics.md

findings.title: Publisher terminal paths have different process closure guarantees
findings.body: Timeout awaits termination result; output-limit and dispose request termination without awaiting. Stdin error calls finish, clears timer and active child reference without terminating it. Throwing onHealth can prevent promise resolution; per-stream output cap follows string concatenation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D762 Publisher terminal paths have different process closure guarantees.md

findings.title: Extension authority evaluator is separate from active host handoff
findings.body: decideAuthority checks supplied ID presence/flags, not authenticity/currentness or atomic ownership. Source search found production codexHostHandoffDecision calls but no decideAuthority invocation. Handoff handles workspace-read/write and Git reasons, with no general effect vocabulary validation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D763 Extension authority evaluator is separate from active host handoff.md

findings.title: JavaScript provider policy conformance is not provider enforcement
findings.body: Extension imports/re-exports helpers without direct production call found. Comparisons do not contact provider or enforce network/charge; exact_receipt_required checks flag, not actual receipt. Digest unkeyed and full schema not validated.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D764 JavaScript provider policy conformance is not provider enforcement.md

findings.title: Provider policy request binding and numeric checks have gaps
findings.body: Requires provider_id but does not compare it with request. Negative expected charge passes safe-integer/max check; both missing budget IDs can match. Unknown fallback rank labels compare as -1 and may pass equal unknown primary labels.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D765 Provider policy request binding and numeric checks have gaps.md

findings.title: Extension wiring tests use fake effects and selected vectors
findings.body: Publisher tests use fake children/JSON success, activation fake disposables, SDK array emitter, authority supplied labels and policy shared mutation vectors. These prove selected helper behavior rather than actual Python bus acceptance, host process closure or provider enforcement.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D766 Extension wiring tests use fake effects and selected vectors.md

findings.title: Eighteen dashboard routes share seven renderer families
findings.body: Core two, catalog two, operational six, system three, observability two, advanced two and graph one are selected by controller. Context checks ensure snapshot/helper presence, not complete nested schemas; malformed supplied arrays can still throw.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D767 Eighteen dashboard routes share seven renderer families.md

findings.title: Rendered controls remain separate from host effect authority
findings.body: Renderers generate HTML data-action attributes. Setup, run, plugin management, repair, knowledge promotion, graph fetch and memory reconciliation occur only through later handlers; their visibility is not a work admission.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D768 Rendered controls remain separate from host effect authority.md

findings.title: Project map counts and visible rows have different bounds
findings.body: Project page further slices entries/services/packages to ten and routes to sixteen while displaying supplied returned/total counts. Static test links and map valid flags are supplied structural evidence, not runtime execution receipts. Inspect actions index current controller drilldown arrays.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D769 Project map counts and visible rows have different bounds.md

findings.title: Catalog badges and session liveness need precise interpretation
findings.body: Several broker/lifecycle/hash/parallel labels are constants. Active enterprise session count requires active status and age at most five minutes, without rejecting future heartbeat timestamps. Registered, runnable and running counts have separate meanings.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D770 Catalog badges and session liveness need precise interpretation.md

findings.title: Plugin rows require matching supplied inventory generation
findings.body: Renderer accepts fresh or memory-current label only with equal compact/shard snapshot hashes; otherwise suppresses rows. No independent clock check occurs. It displays at most 120 rows but metrics describe supplied inventory; ACTIVE/DETECTED does not mean enabled.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D771 Plugin rows require matching supplied inventory generation.md

findings.title: Lifecycle history is local retained state in this renderer
findings.body: Lifecycle displays first twelve webview history entries and full local count; it does not query durable run history. Separate run-browser controls are the route to durable results.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D772 Lifecycle history is local retained state in this renderer.md

findings.title: Diagnostics separates current blockers from retained failures
findings.body: Live host identity, invalid map, stale inventory, unverified MCP and repair state drive current traces. Retained failures and old unclosed punch history remain historical. Invalid/checkpoint-stale/recovery ledger states suppress normal card content.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D773 Diagnostics separates current blockers from retained failures.md

findings.title: Diagnostic visual limits can differ from displayed totals
findings.body: Readiness bar uses a finite clamped zero-to-five value while label retains supplied score/maximum. Trace list is sliced to twelve but metric counts all constructed traces. Maturity and ceiling are supplied assessments, not recomputed guarantees.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D774 Diagnostic visual limits can differ from displayed totals.md

findings.title: Settings rendering does not connect or bill
findings.body: Configuration boundary table and master/model controls describe supplied configuration. Render-time availability does not establish backend connectivity or trigger provider work; handlers own later effects.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D775 Settings rendering does not connect or bill.md

findings.title: Memory readiness and displayed records are separate conditions
findings.body: Canonical query controls require retrieval_ready exactly true; portable context is separately labeled. Existing response rows are rendered from state, while controller owns detached-state clearing. Renderer does not certify integrity or reread canonical storage.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D776 Memory readiness and displayed records are separate conditions.md

findings.title: Activity classification trusts producer liveness and vocabulary
findings.body: Renderer deduplicates stale correlations and excludes seven terminal status strings from active rows, but timed_out is absent. It does not recompute agent heartbeat age. Missing capture policy can produce an ACTIVE presentation; supplied integrity flags determine badges.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D777 Activity classification trusts producer liveness and vocabulary.md

findings.title: Learning raw state can expose action despite blocked effective state
findings.body: Raw candidate state branches precede some effective-state gating, so a raw validated candidate may show Admit while effective state is blocked. Backend admission remains necessary. Missing available flag does not disable creation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D778 Learning raw state can expose action despite blocked effective state.md

findings.title: Knowledge control presentation accepts schema presence
findings.body: Any truthy core schema_version selects proposal controls. Raw proposal state and supplied action availability decide buttons; renderer neither validates schema version nor performs verify/approve/promote/rollback.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D779 Knowledge control presentation accepts schema presence.md

findings.title: Runtime record order is deliberately mirrored by inspect handler
findings.body: Operations reversed then capped at twelve; producer, placement, provider and startup arrays use their own ordering. Controller reconstructs the same array for index-based inspection. Active work display has no renderer-side freshness check.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D780 Runtime record order is deliberately mirrored by inspect handler.md

findings.title: Graph coverage is a supplied pagination statement
findings.body: Graph draws only edges with both endpoints loaded, but selected incident inspector can request unloaded endpoints. Missing has-more flags can display complete even if totals differ; renderer does not establish full-universe completeness by count equality.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D781 Graph coverage is a supplied pagination statement.md

findings.title: Graph layout and viewport accounting have separate bounds
findings.body: Scene dimensions grow with community size; dataset geometry clamps do not necessarily bound raw SVG viewBox. All loaded elements are constructed before controller viewport handling. Scene key omits query, relation, direction and revision; actual reuse consequences depend on controller.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D782 Graph layout and viewport accounting have separate bounds.md

findings.title: Graph connection labels may describe selected-neighbor edges
findings.body: Per-node connection expression filters selected-node incident edges then falls back to item.degree only if result is zero. A neighbor may show its links to selected node instead of its full graph degree. Incident relations over 180 are grouped for label presentation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D783 Graph connection labels may describe selected-neighbor edges.md

findings.title: Surface tests establish fixture and source contracts
findings.body: System and scaffold tests use VM snapshots, regex assertions, fake bridge messages, CSS duplicate baselines and selected token contrasts. They do not prove real DOM layouts, click-to-native execution, current backend evidence or whole semantics of controller/editor files loaded by tests.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D784 Surface tests establish fixture and source contracts.md

findings.title: Wave completion percentage loses the canonical complete status
findings.body: Raw statusGroup recognizes reconciled as complete. taskRow emits complete, then projectWaves passes that normalized status back to authoritativeProgress, where it becomes queued. A wave whose rows are all complete can therefore report complete status with zero percent.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D785 Wave completion percentage loses the canonical complete status.md

findings.title: Wave and plan eligible denominators diverge
findings.body: Raw plan progress excludes explicitly approved cancelled/skipped tasks. Wave progress rebuilds rows with only status and weight, dropping disposition approval, so those tasks remain in wave denominator. Punch uses raw tasks and a separate unweighted denominator.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D786 Wave and plan eligible denominators diverge.md

findings.title: Bounded sidebar output does not bound source graph work
findings.body: Dependency recursion visits every supplied task before slicing eighty tasks and twelve wave groups. Missing dependencies ignored, cycles produce fallback levels instead of invalidating graph, and duplicate task IDs collapse lookup. Deep inputs remain a stack/resource concern.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D787 Bounded sidebar output does not bound source graph work.md

findings.title: Wave claims and display identities have weaker selection rules
findings.body: Wave row takes first claim with matching task ID regardless of claim status. Invalid task IDs use shared fallback and composed subtask IDs can collide or exceed final schema limit. Current canonical ownership is not independently resolved by display rows.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D788 Wave claims and display identities have weaker selection rules.md

findings.title: Agent liveness and attention retain bounded projection assumptions
findings.body: Future agent heartbeat clamps to age zero. Retained stale agents expire from display after fifteen minutes, but all sessions are processed before final twelve-row slice. Twelve original attention rows can crowd out appended blocked/fallback/billing notices when final slice is applied.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D789 Agent liveness and attention retain bounded projection assumptions.md

findings.title: Provider telemetry presence differs from current healthy telemetry
findings.body: Provider rows sliced before priority sort, future timestamps accepted fresh, stale rows reset activity to idle. Telemetry subsystem reports healthy whenever any providerActivity entries exist, including all-stale data. Configured count combines allowlist with only retained provider rows.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D790 Provider telemetry presence differs from current healthy telemetry.md

findings.title: Absent telemetry is rendered as zero billable activity
findings.body: With configured providers but no rows, renderer displays NO BILLABLE API ACTIVITY and zero active requests. Projection itself labels configured-but-missing telemetry unavailable. Missing observation therefore produces a stronger display claim than source evidence supports.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D791 Absent telemetry is rendered as zero billable activity.md

findings.title: Sidebar schema checks occur after full serialization
findings.body: 256 KiB message cap is applied after JSON.stringify allocation. Undefined serialization result reaches Buffer.byteLength outside serialization catch. Strict schema prevents unknown fields but arbitrary outbound input may contain eighty tasks per wave across twelve waves without a total-eighty refinement.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D792 Sidebar schema checks occur after full serialization.md

findings.title: Render acknowledgement is bound only to revision equality
findings.body: Host accepts same-revision message and increments count without comparing expected record counts, snapshot digest/generated time, active view or prior acknowledgement. Claimed visible component count is schema-bounded rather than independently verified by host.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D793 Render acknowledgement is bound only to revision equality.md

findings.title: Browser ordering deliberately permits revision regression with newer clock
findings.body: Only lower revision combined with nonnewer generated time is rejected. Lower revision/newer timestamp and same revision/older timestamp can render; latest values then replace prior ordering state. Browser test explicitly exercises first behavior.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D794 Browser ordering deliberately permits revision regression with newer clock.md

findings.title: Incremental component hashes omit some rendered dependencies
findings.body: Header hash uses state/version/revision but renders label/connected too. Punch hash uses punch counts but its button also embeds execution plan ID; switching plan with equal counts can preserve old navigation target. Hash gating occurs after HTML string construction.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D795 Incremental component hashes omit some rendered dependencies.md

findings.title: Preference persistence is ordered but not serialized
findings.body: Host awaits workspaceState.update before republish, while browser updates expansion locally immediately. Concurrent receives can read same old preference object and overwrite one another; host failure does not automatically roll back optimistic DOM.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D796 Preference persistence is ordered but not serialized.md

findings.title: Snapshot publication and delivery evidence have separate states
findings.body: pushSnapshot stores snapshot before calculation and records lastSerialized/envelope before awaiting postMessage; false return not interpreted. GeneratedAt and projectionMs usually change, weakening deduplication. pushSnapshot posts hidden views while post(error) suppresses them.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D797 Snapshot publication and delivery evidence have separate states.md

findings.title: Some async sidebar callback failures bypass local diagnostic catch
findings.body: openControlPlane/openEntity/retryConnection callbacks are returned without await inside try. Rejected callback promises can escape receive catch; event subscription invokes receive with void. Diagnostic callbacks themselves can throw.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D798 Some async sidebar callback failures bypass local diagnostic catch.md

findings.title: Repeated sidebar resolution needs view-specific listener custody
findings.body: resolve stores listeners until provider dispose; an older view dispose callback sets this.view null without checking identity. Existing acknowledgement state is retained across resolution. dispose loop has no per-disposable failure isolation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D799 Repeated sidebar resolution needs view-specific listener custody.md

findings.title: Browser contract and formatting trust strict host producer
findings.body: Browser validates limited top-level shape and revision, not nested projection schema. Invalid currency string can throw Intl.NumberFormat despite host currency length bound; stale age timer only updates already-stale labels, never reclassifies live agents/providers.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D800 Browser contract and formatting trust strict host producer.md

findings.title: Sidebar navigation uses current bounded projection membership
findings.body: Provider selection checks current rows, while openEntity forwards any schema-valid ID. entityRecord searches bounded projection and returns clone or null; extension opens route with this result. This is navigation, not evidence of underlying mutation authorization.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D801 Sidebar navigation uses current bounded projection membership.md

findings.title: Legacy tree definition is not the active sidebar
findings.body: ControlCenterTreeProvider defines six flat items and emitter without dispose. Extension source search found only definition/export; actual controlCenter registration uses SidebarViewProvider. Avoid counting both as active presentation paths.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D802 Legacy tree definition is not the active sidebar.md

findings.title: Projection and protocol tests leave progress and acknowledgement gaps
findings.body: Fixtures test raw weighted plan counts and wave IDs but not wave percent/disposition loss. Host tests accept equal revision without expected count comparison and test awaited storage in isolation. They do not establish current installed rendering evidence.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D803 Projection and protocol tests leave progress and acknowledgement gaps.md

findings.title: Sidebar browser test proves preview interactions when run
findings.body: Test uses actual Chromium preview, synthetic snapshots, keyboard/layout assertions and forced-color screenshot, with browser cleanup. Manifest includes all existing PNGs rather than only current screenshot. It is not actual VS Code/native billing execution and was read, not run, in this report pass.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D804 Sidebar browser test proves preview interactions when run.md

findings.title: Starter setup is a concrete ten-operation execution sequence
findings.body: Normal path issues nine approvals and ten operations, with workflow dry-run unsigned. Agent completes before workflow starts; selected test/admission/run flags required. It is operational setup, whereas draft save remains unadmitted.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D805 Starter setup is a concrete ten-operation execution sequence.md

findings.title: Starter ready result relies on selected fields and lacks multi-step recovery
findings.body: Create and register-authority receipts are not exact-validated. Dry-run checks effects_executed false but not runnable true; run IDs need not be present. Earlier effects remain when a later step throws; no durable resume checkpoint or compensating rollback.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D806 Starter ready result relies on selected fields and lacks multi-step recovery.md

findings.title: Starter version recovery uses a different conflict boundary
findings.body: Starter helper accepts named Error code/reason or an immutable-builder traceback suffix. It may create initial 1.0.0 then allocate; candidate allocation receives only numeric version regex check here. Strict draft path instead uses exact structured backend conflict classification supplied by extension.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D807 Starter version recovery uses a different conflict boundary.md

findings.title: Starter definition immutability is shallow
findings.body: Object.freeze protects top-level exported starter objects, while nested grant/binding/node arrays and objects remain mutable. Setup clones the current exported structure each invocation. Exact approval payload clone does not restore a mutated starter baseline.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D808 Starter definition immutability is shallow.md

findings.title: Host trust registry binds origin request exact value and expiry
findings.body: Source and allocation maps share total/per-origin quotas, reject duplicate same-map issuance request and permit one-use consumption. Values are canonical serialized snapshots; registry itself does not authenticate files or external actors. Wall clock supplied to expiry remains an assumption.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D809 Host trust registry binds origin request exact value and expiry.md

findings.title: Trust JSON rejects many non-JSON forms but is not a resource bound
findings.body: Serializer rejects nonfinite numbers, cycles, unpaired surrogates, object accessors and nonplain objects; arrays use element access and do not apply equivalent descriptor checks. Recursive serialization has no depth/byte cap before result size checks. Sorted string keys use JavaScript ordering; cross-language parity must use matching canonical rules.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D810 Trust JSON rejects many non-JSON forms but is not a resource bound.md

findings.title: Allocation observation and backend publication remain separate
findings.body: Host compares exact allocation binding except observed_utc before confirmation, consumes proof afterward, and recovers supplied-allocation publication collisions with a fresh token. Potentially long confirmation separates last allocation observation from actual create; backend owns collision/atomicity enforcement.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D811 Allocation observation and backend publication remain separate.md

findings.title: Initial create has two absence observations without host atomic reservation
findings.body: Proofless create requires version 1.0.0 and exact backend absence receipt before and after confirmation. These observations do not reserve identity. If initial create collides later, this coordinator lacks supplied allocation and rethrows rather than manufacturing a recovery proof.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D812 Initial create has two absence observations without host atomic reservation.md

findings.title: External skill lineage is reauthenticated after confirmation
findings.body: Selected canonical/preserved package hashes and counts are reread; source equality required before creation. Reserved preserved-original provenance supplied by caller is stripped and reconstructed from host lineage. This observes content, not a filesystem lock through commit.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D813 External skill lineage is reauthenticated after confirmation.md

findings.title: Standard skill domain screening is a partial semantic filter
findings.body: capability.json must be px-standard; restricted namespace values scanned only under selected key patterns. skill.yaml uses JSON parse or regex fallback rather than a full YAML parser. This screen is not full package contract validation; native admission remains necessary.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D814 Standard skill domain screening is a partial semantic filter.md

findings.title: Materialization is bound to source admission before draft create
findings.body: Host compares exact materialization fields/inventory, source directory physical equality and admitted tree/count, then strips editor_files and supplies source token. Errors before valid commit, including conflict or malformed receipt, retain materialized input rather than claiming reclaimed closure.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D815 Materialization is bound to source admission before draft create.md

findings.title: Create receipt classification separates shape proof from artifact proof
findings.body: Agent/workflow receipt requires exact schema, identity/version, stopped/unadmitted state, hash shapes and path bounds; host does not reopen every referenced artifact. Skill result additionally matches source token/tree/count/files and canonical manifest digest. These strengths should not be represented as identical.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D816 Create receipt classification separates shape proof from artifact proof.md

findings.title: Malformed result is an unverified outcome rather than failed create
findings.body: Host emits studioDraftOutcomeUnverified, attempts catalog refresh and returns no trusted result. A valid commit with notification/refresh failure retains created/recovered status plus warnings. Neither branch automatically retries create or rolls back persistent effects.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D817 Malformed result is an unverified outcome rather than failed create.md

findings.title: Production warning text overstates the unverified branch
findings.body: The same reportPostCommitWarning callback is invoked for invalid commit receipt. Extension callback logs and warns that the immutable revision committed, even though host coordinator classified outcome unverified. Catalog recovery is needed to resolve that uncertainty.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D818 Production warning text overstates the unverified branch.md

findings.title: Package normalization is topology and byte exact
findings.body: 128-file, 512 KiB-file, 2 MiB-total, directory/depth/path bounds apply. Case aliases, file/directory collisions, Windows device/stream names, non-NFC segments, unpaired surrogates and NUL are rejected. Tree digest length-frames exact UTF-8 bytes and retains BOM on read.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D819 Package normalization is topology and byte exact.md

findings.title: Materialized input publication is direct final-directory construction
findings.body: Target combines sanitized identity/version plus hash suffixes. Existing trees require exact content and topology; new trees written directly with exclusive files and verified afterward. Concurrent writer can encounter incomplete target and fail rather than wait; failure retains partial tree.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D820 Materialized input publication is direct final-directory construction.md

findings.title: Lifecycle records do not provide crash-atomic publication
findings.body: Parent/staging/lifecycle directories can be created before registered receipt. Receipt writes are exclusive but not fsynced; content publication and closed receipt are separate. A published tree can remain after closure-write failure and require later recovery.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D821 Lifecycle records do not provide crash-atomic publication.md

findings.title: Package read bounds do not create a coherent filesystem snapshot
findings.body: Traversal checks links and opens bounded regular files using O_NOFOLLOW where available. It compares bytes read with opened size, but no lock binds entire traversal or detects every same-size mutation/ancestor replacement. Root inputs resolved to physical paths before checks; root authority comes from caller.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D822 Package read bounds do not create a coherent filesystem snapshot.md

findings.title: Reused materialized input has no shared-consumer lease
findings.body: Deterministic target may be reused by independent operations, each with its own lifecycle receipt. Successful create can reclaim that shared path without a refcount/lease check for other consumers. Reattestation checks content, not concurrent usage.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D823 Reused materialized input has no shared-consumer lease.md

findings.title: Reclamation has explicit evidence boundaries and a post-delete receipt gap
findings.body: Success path checks materialization/create/lifecycle identity, attests tree, moves to unique containment, reattests, deletes and then publishes reclaimed receipt. Failure after deletion but before durable receipt can leave removed input without verified completion receipt. Audit only maps this effect and does not execute it.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D824 Reclamation has explicit evidence boundaries and a post-delete receipt gap.md

findings.title: Preserved package read completeness differs from native input completeness
findings.body: Reader confines engine/project paths and rejects extra empty topology, binary/special/link content. Preserved-original reads may omit native core files and report missingRequiredFiles; ordinary materialization still requires SKILL.md, capability.json and skill.yaml.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D825 Preserved package read completeness differs from native input completeness.md

findings.title: Studio tests span source checks mocks and real defined integration
findings.body: Wiring tests inspect regexes; host coordinator tests mostly supply receipts; package tests exercise local files and optional links; bootstrap includes actual host-to-Python runs with disposable roots if executed. None was run as part of this report, and their existence is not a current installed-system pass.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D826 Studio tests span source checks mocks and real defined integration.md

findings.title: Workflow normalization can remove problems before validation
findings.body: Unknown kind becomes task, nonvalidation config cleared, dangling edges filtered out, and missing nodes/default ports synthesized. The validator then sees repaired state rather than the original imported definition. Contract derivation identifies undriven node inputs.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D827 Workflow normalization can remove problems before validation.md

findings.title: Workflow and agent default authority labels differ
findings.body: Workflow grants/bindings default to admitted and human-approval receipt strings; agent declarations default candidate. Persisted authority-unavailable marker prevents synthesizing missing definitions. These are editor values, not authenticated work authority.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D828 Workflow and agent default authority labels differ.md

findings.title: Workflow input requiredness can be relaxed by supplied contract
findings.body: Derived contract takes port type and undriven key, but a supplied matching contract row can set required false even for required port. Normalization retains supplied run_inputs; runtime input values remain separately supplied and not persisted by canonical authority fixture.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D829 Workflow input requiredness can be relaxed by supplied contract.md

findings.title: Workflow editor validator is a partial structural boundary
findings.body: Checks acyclicity, ports/types, duplicate drivers, branch boolean alternatives, join incoming count and declared grant/binding references. It does not enforce integer retry/timeout, full binding identity/version validity or authenticated approvers; empty graph is not independently rejected if called without normalization.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D830 Workflow editor validator is a partial structural boundary.md

findings.title: Editor configuration byte wording uses string length
findings.body: Workflow config limit compares JSON.stringify(...).length with 16384, which counts UTF-16 code units rather than UTF-8 bytes. Fuzzy ranking traverses all supplied records/tokens before limiting twenty results; output limits do not bound computation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D831 Editor configuration byte wording uses string length.md

findings.title: Agent graph validator checks closed topology rather than full config semantics
findings.body: Canonical node identities/order, exact port arrays, config key sets, edge serialization and graph identity checked. Config values are not all type/meaning checked here, and JSON property ordering participates in exact ports/edge comparison. Separate spec and backend validation remain needed.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D832 Agent graph validator checks closed topology rather than full config semantics.md

findings.title: Agent synchronization and node editing have different omission behavior
findings.body: Working synchronization preserves existing edge omissions and only adds edges for newly declared optional nodes. Explicit add/remove/retype node path instead calls projectAgentBuilderGraph and reconstructs all canonical edges, so an unrelated prior missing edge can reappear.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D833 Agent synchronization and node editing have different omission behavior.md

findings.title: Optional Agent nodes carry declaration changes as well as geometry
findings.body: Removing/retyping tools, handoffs or memory clears source declaration array; retype moves saved coordinates. New node layout searches free default positions. Candidate payload includes graph/layout/grants/bindings, while backend still owns actual authority.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D834 Optional Agent nodes carry declaration changes as well as geometry.md

findings.title: Custom editor instruction hashing has its own Unicode boundary
findings.body: Synchronous SHA-256 encoder expands code points manually but does not reject unpaired surrogate code units. Those encode differently from standard replacement-character UTF-8 behavior. Host exact trust serializer rejects unpaired surrogates; browser graph hash alone is not cross-runtime identity assurance.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D835 Custom editor instruction hashing has its own Unicode boundary.md

findings.title: Agent model normalization and structural validity do not prove a live route
findings.body: Unknown provider defaults deterministic unless host harness implies vscode-lm. Host route requires exact model strings but editor does not query provider availability. Token bounds allow fractional values. Memory/handoff references yield warnings while structural valid can remain true; self-handoff alone is rejected locally.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D836 Agent model normalization and structural validity do not prove a live route.md

findings.title: Agent declarations need stronger runtime resolution
findings.body: Effect/scope/evidence strings checked for presence, grant expiry only parses as a date, and root schemas only require type object. Closed test IDs do not require all checks or unique checks. Runtime owner must authenticate and resolve declarations before execution.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D837 Agent declarations need stronger runtime resolution.md

findings.title: Skill identity synchronization can overwrite manifest-specific data
findings.body: Synchronization merges missing defaults, updates capability identity/domain/schema and writes its full JSON to both capability.json and skill.yaml. Distinct YAML-only fields disappear. SKILL.md name update only handles LF opening frontmatter, while preparation catches errors and returns prior normalized draft.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D838 Skill identity synchronization can overwrite manifest-specific data.md

findings.title: Skill editor validation is weaker than native package validation
findings.body: Browser path checks cover basic absolute/traversal cases but not host byte/file/topology/case/device-name bounds. Contract links need an array without requiring each target exists; resource index checks listed files but not completeness. YAML fallback regex is not a full parser. Host materializer and admission must enforce their own contracts.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D839 Skill editor validation is weaker than native package validation.md

findings.title: Local history recorded is not a successful run classification
findings.body: historyEntry reads status/state or valid false, but not run_state/run_outcome. A run-specific result may therefore be summarized as recorded. Selected revision/hash fallbacks likewise omit some operation-specific fields.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D840 Local history recorded is not a successful run classification.md

findings.title: Catalog round-trip fixtures prove selected artifact relationships
findings.body: Agent fixtures bind graph/layout/spec/compiler hashes and reject selected rehashed semantic substitution; workflow fixtures bind layout/revision/authority and omit runtime input values. Missing modern artifacts fail, legacy unavailable state remains read-only. Fixtures manufacture receipts instead of invoking Python compiler/publication.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D841 Catalog round-trip fixtures prove selected artifact relationships.md

findings.title: Agent graph source test is only a wiring assertion
findings.body: Small test checks current upgrade and select-node source strings and excludes obsolete select-section strings. It exercises no DOM or graph transformation. Neither it nor catalog fixtures establishes whole controller review or current installed execution.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D842 Agent graph source test is only a wiring assertion.md

findings.title: Physical catalog scans on access
findings.body: Both all and getExtension rescan disk. Some consumers access all twice. Directory enumeration and full manifest reads precede parts of the cap enforcement; caller-supplied limits have no fixed upper ceiling.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D843 Physical catalog scans on access.md

findings.title: Obsolete marker retry blocks the extension host
findings.body: Invalid JSON is retried up to eight reads with synchronous Atomics.wait intervals. Read failures caught as invalid JSON can also retry. This is bounded retry, not asynchronous host work.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D844 Obsolete marker retry blocks the extension host.md

findings.title: Loaded activation is matched by version rather than physical identity
findings.body: Physical records become active from loaded version equality and isActive; path/content identity is not compared. External loaded records can contain duplicates. Realpath establishes the scan root but does not prove original supplied alias identity.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D845 Loaded activation is matched by version rather than physical identity.md

findings.title: Conflict signals are declaration overlaps
findings.body: Contributions can collide even within one extension. Keybinding keys from all platforms are sorted together and when expressions compared as text, permitting false positives and missed effective-platform overlaps. Signals do not prove runtime conflict.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D846 Conflict signals are declaration overlaps.md

findings.title: Conflict ordering and identity have limited semantics
findings.body: Severity sorting is lexical. Signal IDs generally omit package version; duplicate dependencies/signals can remain. Result limits apply after signal construction, so output bounds do not bound computation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D847 Conflict ordering and identity have limited semantics.md

findings.title: Preview consumption and capacity affect retries
findings.body: Execute prunes while map size is at least 64 and consumes token before approval/exact-target validation. At capacity the oldest live preview can be evicted during execution. No operation mutex or owner binding closes concurrent target changes.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D848 Preview consumption and capacity affect retries.md

findings.title: Local package hash does not authenticate requested extension identity
findings.body: Source realpath, nonempty regular file and SHA-256 are checked, but VSIX package metadata is not read to bind requested extension ID/version. Whole file read has no size ceiling and native host opens path later. Native host owns its own package trust checks.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D849 Local package hash does not authenticate requested extension identity.md

findings.title: Immediate reconciliation has operation-specific meaning
findings.body: Install/update checks immediate observed target/version. Unversioned update with unchanged version can be reconciled as no-version-change; this is not an independent marketplace-latest check. Enablement only opens native manager and explicitly remains unreconciled.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D850 Immediate reconciliation has operation-specific meaning.md

findings.title: Uninstall consumer state is frozen at preview
findings.body: Target version is rechecked at execute, but reverse dependencies and extensionPack consumers are not recalculated. A consumer added after preview is outside the acknowledgment shown to user.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D851 Uninstall consumer state is frozen at preview.md

findings.title: Uninstall history and native mutation are separate commits
findings.body: Retained history is written/read back before uninstall command, but storage updates lack concurrency transaction. Install/update local source retention can fail after native command. Thus a thrown operation can follow a native effect and a retained record can exist without completed uninstall.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D852 Uninstall history and native mutation are separate commits.md

findings.title: Rollback history does not mean bytes are retained
findings.body: Update rollback target is a result field rather than durable version history. Local source map retains latest path/hash; an empty requested version may not match observed version later. Rollback without local bytes delegates exact version retrieval to native host.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D853 Rollback history does not mean bytes are retained.md

findings.title: Rollback record validation and consumption have gaps
findings.body: Execute rechecks selected record identity/state but not full version/source equality. Local source is rehashed. Successful observed restore precedes consumed-history write, which can fail after installation; wrong/pending observed version leaves retained record while occupied target blocks another rollback.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D854 Rollback record validation and consumption have gaps.md

findings.title: Conflict route continues through a fresh preview
findings.body: Host resolution returns lifecycle_route, and controller correlates request then requests install, uninstall or disable preview. This is real integration, but routing alone performs no native mutation. Inspect route opens native search.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D855 Conflict route continues through a fresh preview.md

findings.title: Existing environment snapshot is metadata evidence
findings.body: Manager snapshots names, sizes, truncated mtime and file identity rather than file contents. Same-size content edits with restored metadata can escape comparison. Caller flags and containment do not independently establish ownership or current consumer state. Cleanup remains skipped.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D856 Existing environment snapshot is metadata evidence.md

findings.title: Existing environment receipt follows the move
findings.body: Preview storage has no TTL/cap and returns shared object. Rename precedes durable receipt write with no compensating rollback. Restore trusts partly validated receipt fields and does not establish original parent identity. These branches were inspected only.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D857 Existing environment receipt follows the move.md

findings.title: Lifecycle fixtures are not installed-system evidence
findings.body: Tests simulate native commands/storage and use synthetic package bytes. They cover selected exact target, source change, expiry, custody and conflict branches, but not native package identity, concurrency, full-capacity eviction or post-effect storage failure.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D858 Lifecycle fixtures are not installed-system evidence.md

findings.title: Activity append admits parseability rather than prior hash integrity
findings.body: recordActivity refuses malformed JSONL but does not call eventIntegrity before append. A parsed tampered or state-divergent log can receive a new event linked to state.last_event_sha256. Appending event and replacing state are distinct commits.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D859 Activity append admits parseability rather than prior hash integrity.md

findings.title: Activity tail limits do not bound file reading or parsing
findings.body: Entire JSONL is read and split, every valid line parsed until syntax failure, and only then sliced to tail. JSON shape/schema is not validated before integrity/filters; valid JSON such as null can make read paths throw.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D860 Activity tail limits do not bound file reading or parsing.md

findings.title: Local chain consistency has partial counter semantics
findings.body: Tail hashes and internal links checked; first tail predecessor is not anchored. State counter greater than retained tail is considered truncation, not necessarily corruption. Missing empty log with nonzero count can avoid counterDrift because no final event exists.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D861 Local chain consistency has partial counter semantics.md

findings.title: Local state reads can retain evidence while failing
findings.body: readState preserves corrupt bytes and receipt before throwing, so the read path can write local evidence. Semantic checks on parsed state are incomplete; unlocked readers can observe log/state between separate publications.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D862 Local state reads can retain evidence while failing.md

findings.title: Activity lock serializes cooperative writers with race limits
findings.body: Lock uses PID/host/token and busy retry, protects live same-host PID and checks token on release. No process-start identity binds PID reuse; compare-to-rename/unlink gaps remain. Temp replacements have no fsync or failure cleanup.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D863 Activity lock serializes cooperative writers with race limits.md

findings.title: Activity redaction depends on field names
findings.body: Secret/content-like keys are redacted with depth/array/key caps; arbitrary sensitive text under an innocuous key is not detected. Relative scopes are lexical rather than realpath identities. Captured-content false is a schema declaration, not arbitrary-secret proof.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D864 Activity redaction depends on field names.md

findings.title: Stale activity is an observation not process cancellation
findings.body: Stale reconciliation emits cancelled observation and removes operation state without stopping a process. It checks a fresh state before calling separately locked recordActivity, leaving a renewal race. Invalid/future heartbeat values can stay outside expected stale classification.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D865 Stale activity is an observation not process cancellation.md

findings.title: Activity repair reseals supplied event contents
findings.body: Repair backups retain exact old files then rewrites predecessor hashes for parsed contents and appends recovery event. This restores internal consistency, not original truth. Active operations and agents are retained from prior state rather than rebuilt from events.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D866 Activity repair reseals supplied event contents.md

findings.title: Repair completeness depends on an untrusted counter
findings.body: Repair refuses a capped tail only when state.event_count exceeds tail length. If a longer actual log has an underreported count and integrity fails, the retained tail can be rewritten as the new whole log, with originals in backup. No repair was invoked.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D867 Repair completeness depends on an untrusted counter.md

findings.title: Repair publications and hash descriptions need separate interpretation
findings.body: Log replacement, state replacement and receipt are separate writes. Postcondition checks memory rather than rereading disk. Recovery.output_sha256 hashes an intermediate serialization before final output/hash fields are changed; receipt.repaired_events_sha256 binds final text.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D868 Repair publications and hash descriptions need separate interpretation.md

findings.title: Listener coverage complete means available registration coverage
findings.body: markRegistered marks available enabled listeners healthy even with zero events. Unsupported required APIs are reported as limitations but omitted from incomplete denominator. Drops remain sticky; bus status is a separate last-result projection.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D869 Listener coverage complete means available registration coverage.md

findings.title: Listener API inventory is coarser than individual callbacks
findings.body: Editor availability checks change API but not open/save/close; task checks start/end but not process result. SCM attaches only to already-active Git at registration. Nested SCM registration errors are logged rather than failing whole registration.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D870 Listener API inventory is coarser than individual callbacks.md

findings.title: File capture toggle is not checked by every filesystem callback
findings.body: Editor and watcher callbacks check captureFileEvents, but onDidCreateFiles/delete/rename callbacks only check excluded paths. recordActivity checks global enabled/paused, not category capture toggles, so direct workspace file events can still record when that category toggle is false.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D871 File capture toggle is not checked by every filesystem callback.md

findings.title: Watcher aggregation counts unique keys and repeats overflow per group
findings.body: 256 operation/scope entries coalesce repeats and 64 scopes per group are retained, then local ledger further caps scopes at 50. A single overflow count is placed in every emitted operation group. Continuous editor/SCM events use trailing debounce; their maps have no equivalent fixed cap.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D872 Watcher aggregation counts unique keys and repeats overflow per group.md

findings.title: Host lifecycle results have differing certainty
findings.body: Terminal session never means executable work. Task-end and debug termination are idle/unknown, while task-process uses exitCode truthiness and absent exitCode becomes succeeded. Shell absent exitCode correctly maps idle. Test callback reports newest result count, not pass/fail proof.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D873 Host lifecycle results have differing certainty.md

findings.title: Canonical activity loses local metadata distinctions
findings.body: Effect converter maps observe/network-like unknown values to read and ignores metadata.observed_effect. Canonical scopes retain project and count, not paths. Extension builds canonical event before local claim/task enrichment, so local and canonical work identity can differ.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D874 Canonical activity loses local metadata distinctions.md

findings.title: Local activity success does not establish canonical publication
findings.body: Extension records locally, then queues canonical publisher. A synchronous error after local record returns recorded false via catch, despite local effect. Delayed publishActivitySoon callback reads current workspace without its own try/catch and coalesces updates by resetting timer.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D875 Local activity success does not establish canonical publication.md

findings.title: Activity tests establish fixture behavior rather than current host proof
findings.body: Local tests mutate tiny logs/state and check selected refusal/repair flags; listener tests fire mock emitters and manual timers. The matrix proves fixture route delivery, not real VS Code APIs or canonical publication. No fresh product tests run in this audit.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D876 Activity tests establish fixture behavior rather than current host proof.md

findings.title: Workflow helper tests and browser implementation are distinct
findings.body: Repository callers import workflowTraceProjection only from its test; controller implements separate trace functions. Source regex assertions verify selected spelling and fields rather than executing browser parity.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D877 Workflow helper tests and browser implementation are distinct.md

findings.title: Workflow trace hash is optional and identity can be inherited
findings.body: Complete identity requires workflow ID/version/run, not revision hash. Conflict checks compare only fields present on both sides. Missing result fields can be inherited from expected identity; no hash syntax, signature or receipt authentication occurs here.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D878 Workflow trace hash is optional and identity can be inherited.md

findings.title: Run list miss preserves current trace without freshness proof
findings.body: List selects first matching current run and returns unchanged on no match. Direct results have no revision/event-time ordering guard. Browser permits new run only for start/run, while resume is processed without that allowance.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D879 Run list miss preserves current trace without freshness proof.md

findings.title: Trace node map has duplicate and special-key semantics
findings.body: Projected node IDs are arbitrary nonempty strings written to a normal object. Duplicate IDs overwrite earlier rows; __proto__ assignment is not treated as an ordinary own node entry. Array/string data is unbounded at this helper layer.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D880 Trace node map has duplicate and special-key semantics.md

findings.title: Failure projection may use generic receipt fields
findings.body: Explicit failure object is preferred, otherwise a failed-state last attempt, otherwise receipt itself. A generic code/message/correlation on receipt can therefore appear under failure even without failed state. Approval/recovery maps are shallow copies, not authority checks.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D881 Failure projection may use generic receipt fields.md

findings.title: Trace fixture authentication is an upstream assumption
findings.body: Test named authenticated durable checkpoint supplies a plain object. It proves chosen fields project, not that runtime authenticated them. Browser rendering checks are source assertions on textContent/title/ARIA, not DOM execution.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D882 Trace fixture authentication is an upstream assumption.md

findings.title: Ollama admission checks only initial HTTP loopback hostname
findings.body: URL accepts loopback HTTP host but does not reject credentials/path/query/fragment or revalidate final response URL. Fetch calls do not supply explicit redirect refusal. No external network behavior was exercised in this audit.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D883 Ollama admission checks only initial HTTP loopback hostname.md

findings.title: Ollama catalog capacities are fixed declarations
findings.body: Catalog maps all returned models and reports 32768 input and 8192 output tokens for each. Body/model count and model field schemas lack bounds; malformed response returns empty list. Token cancellation is checked initially but not subscribed for catalogue request.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D884 Ollama catalog capacities are fixed declarations.md

findings.title: Local provider conversion discards role and content distinctions
findings.body: All non-assistant messages become user and only string part.value content retained. Token estimate is ceil UTF-16 string length divided by four with minimum one. Output-token clamp lacks positive/integer/finite checks and temperature can become nonfinite before JSON conversion.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D885 Local provider conversion discards role and content distinctions.md

findings.title: Stream deadlines cover different intervals
findings.body: Total deadline starts before fetch; idle timeout only races body reads after headers. Progress callbacks may emit partial text before terminal failure. Limit overrides are shallow merged without validating types/ranges.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D886 Stream deadlines cover different intervals.md

findings.title: Streaming line cap also applies to combined chunk buffer
findings.body: After decoding, the entire buffered chunk is byte-counted before splitting lines. A chunk containing many individually small valid lines can exceed line limit and fail, even below total stream limit. Decoder replacement behavior is not configured fatal.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D887 Streaming line cap also applies to combined chunk buffer.md

findings.title: Done event does not stop processing remaining buffered events immediately
findings.body: Every complete line in the current chunk is consumed before completed triggers reader.cancel; trailing buffer is consumed afterward. Thus later text or error in same chunk can follow done. Content field truthiness is checked without string/schema validation.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D888 Done event does not stop processing remaining buffered events immediately.md

findings.title: Provider cleanup is not complete stream ownership closure
findings.body: Finally clears timer and cancellation subscription only. Parser/progress errors do not always cancel reader or abort fetch; successful done attempts cancel. Provider dispose only disposes emitter and does not track or cancel in-flight requests.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D889 Provider cleanup is not complete stream ownership closure.md

findings.title: Ollama tests prove selected synthetic transport branches
findings.body: Fixtures run loopback HTTP responses with no real model and fake VS Code objects. They assert stable faults and explicit done, but not real model capacity, redirects, catalogue, line-boundary chunking or all resource closure paths. Audit reads tests without running them.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D890 Ollama tests prove selected synthetic transport branches.md

findings.title: Message field lists are not complete required-field schemas
findings.body: Generic CONTRACTS rejects unknown top-level keys but many listed fields are optional or lack detailed validation. Graph and selected Studio/lifecycle operations receive stronger checks; ordinary catalogue/environment/coordination payloads rely on downstream owners.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D891 Message field lists are not complete required-field schemas.md

findings.title: Aggregate webview byte bound follows traversal and serialization
findings.body: Depth ten, ten-thousand nodes, one-MiB string length and two-thousand array caps are checked first. Four-MiB total is enforced after JSON.stringify allocates serialized text; many large permitted strings can allocate far more before rejection.
findings.note: 05 Findings/D892 Aggregate webview byte bound follows traversal and serialization.md
